This is a high\-impact leadership role for a Transition Managerwho is ready to shape the future of application transitions — combining deep delivery expertise with AI\-powered innovation to redefine how complex global IT services are handed over, stabilized, and scaled.


We are looking for a seasoned **Application Transition Manager** to lead end\-to\-end planning, solutioning, and execution of complex, multi\-service managed services, application development, and support/maintenance transitions. This role sits at the intersection of delivery leadership, AI\-powered modernization, and enterprise\-scale program governance.


The ideal candidate brings deep hands\-on experience in transitioning large application development/support portfolios — including custom\-built, packaged, and cloud\-native applications — and is fluent in harnessing AI tools, automation, and intelligent accelerators to compress timelines, reduce risk, and elevate transition quality.


You will operate as the single accountable owner across pre\-sales solutioning and live execution, partnering closely with the client, delivery towers, and incumbent vendors to deliver a seamless transition to steady\-state operations.

**Responsibilities**

* Independently design and own transition solutions for complex outsourcing pursuits across multi\-vendor, multi\-geo, multi\-stack, multi\-service (Apps, Infra, Security, Automation, Cloud) environments
* Define transition strategy, milestone frameworks, resource models, and success KPIs for RFP/RFI/SOW responses and contract negotiations
* Defend the proposed transition solutions and execution approaches to senior Client stakeholders / C\-suite audiences (Orals)
* Design AI\-powered transition solutions using GenAI\-based knowledge extraction, automated documentation generation, and intelligent codebase discovery to accelerate solutioning timelines
* Leverage AI estimating models and effort prediction tools to build data\-driven transition business cases and risk\-adjusted transition plans during pre\-sales
* Lead transitions of 100\+ applications spanning custom development, microservices, APIs, data platforms, ERP/CRM systems, and cloud\-native workloads

Manage all transition phases: Knowledge Acquisition Shadow Reverse Shadow Parallel Run Stabilization (Hypercare)* BAU Handover
* Oversee structured code and architecture discovery activities — codebase walkthroughs, dependency mapping, tech\-debt assessment, and environment cataloging
* Ensure delivery of all transition artifacts: SOPs, Runbooks, Application Passports, Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), RACI matrices, and operational documentation
* Manage Knowledge Acquisition sessions across development teams (onshore/offshore), ensuring structured capture of tribal knowledge, design rationale, and undocumented dependencies
* Deploy AI\-based code analysis tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, CodeScene, SonarQube AI) to accelerate codebase understanding, surface tech debt, and auto\-generate inline documentation during Knowledge Acquisition
* Use GenAI\-powered documentation tools to auto\-draft SOPs, Runbooks, and Application Passports from discovery sessions, reducing documentation effort by up to 40%
* Apply AI\-driven dependency mapping tools to visualize application interdependencies, integration touchpoints, and data flows across complex portfolios
* Establish and chair Transition Governance Forums — weekly/bi\-weekly SteerCos, RAID reviews, milestone checkpoint meetings, and executive reporting cadences
* Maintain a real\-time Transition Dashboard tracking milestones, knowledge transfer completion, risk status, team readiness scores, and go\-live criteria
* Drive RAID log management (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies) and proactively resolve blockers impacting transition timelines
* Manage 50\+ active stakeholders — client executives, product owners, architects, vendor leads, and delivery managers — across multiple geographies
* Use AI\-powered project analytics tools and NLP\-based status reporting to auto\-generate executive dashboards and transition health summaries
* Define and execute Go\-Live Readiness Criteria encompassing access provisioning, monitoring setup, SLA framework validation, on\-call rota, and escalation paths
* Lead structured Hypercare operations post\-go\-live: stabilization sprints, defect triage, performance baselining, and SLA attainment tracking
* Ensure tooling readiness: ITSM (ServiceNow), observability stack (Dynatrace, Splunk, Datadog), CMDB accuracy, and alerting configuration
* Integrate AIOps capabilities (anomaly detection, predictive alerting) during Hypercare to proactively surface risks before they escalate to incidents
* Use ML\-based SLA prediction models to benchmark incoming team performance trajectories and forecast BAU stabilization timelines

**Requirements**

* 12–18 years of IT industry experience with significant tenure leading enterprise Application Transition programs
* Minimum 8 years of hands\-on experience transitioning Application Development portfolios within Managed Services or IT Outsourcing environments
* Proven track record managing transitions of 200\+ FTEs and 100\+ applications across multi\-geo delivery models
* Hands\-on exposure to AI tools and automation platforms used across the transition lifecycle (code analysis, documentation generation, test automation, AIOps)
* Experience managing transitions in Agile, SAFe, Waterfall, and Hybrid delivery models; able to adapt governance to match client maturity
* Demonstrated ability to manage 50\+ active stakeholders, including CXOs, Product Owners, Architects, and Vendor Leads
* Strong pre\-sales experience: RFP/RFI responses, SOW development, contract reviews, and client oral presentations
* Exposure to multi\-domain transitions covering Application Development, Application Support, Data \& Analytics, and Integration platforms

**Nice to have**

* Skills in DevOps and CI/CD Migration/Management
* Proficiency in AIOps and Observability
* Background in GenAI Tooling for Development, Prompt Engineering, and AI\-driven Code Analysis Tools
* Experience in Cloud Transition (AWS, Azure, GCP)

title: Geospatial Summer Intern
description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.
   

  

 If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.
   

  

**Skills And Competencies**
* Strong foundation in machine learning, computer vision, and numerical methods
* Experience with CNN\-based architectures and modern vision models
* Solid understanding of remote sensing techniques, including:
* Image classification and segmentation
* Change detection and decorrelation
* Processing of hyperspectral and multispectral imagery
* Proficiency in Python, with hands\-on experience in: Machine Learning frameworks (Scikit\-Learn, TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch, GluonCV, Image processing \& geospatial libraries: OpenCV, GDAL, GeoPandas, Rasterio)
* Familiarity with GIS tools: ESRI suite, QGIS, GRASS
* Exposure to Google Earth Engine is a plus


**Education**
 Pursuing post\-graduation (Masters/PhD) in Geoinformatics, Remote Sensing, Earth Sciences, Computer Science or Graduate in Civil Engineering, Computer Science, Environmental Science from an institute of good repute
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 The Geospatial team at Moody’s is developing advanced AI/ML capabilities, including Large Vision Models (LVMs) and Generative/Agentic AI, to extract insights from large\-scale satellite and aerial imagery. These capabilities enable scalable analysis of remote sensing data, supporting accurate detection of objects, patterns, and temporal changes, Key initiatives include:
   

  

* Global Property Project: building high\-resolution global datasets of building stock
* Global Renewable Energy Project: mapping solar and wind assets worldwide


 As an AI/ML Intern, you will contribute to these high\-impact programmes by:
   

  

* Developing and applying vision models to geospatial challenges
* Working on tasks such as: Image enhancement (denoising, super\-resolution), building footprint extraction, renewable asset detection, multi\-temporal change detection
* Supporting the integration of LVMs and generative AI into production workflows


 This role offers hands\-on experience with scalable, production\-grade AI systems while contributing to global geospatial intelligence solutions.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our Geospatial Team (Model Development Group) is responsible for developing critical geospatial datasets, exposure intelligence, and modeling components that underpin Moody’s industry\-leading catastrophe risk solutions used by more than 400 clients worldwide. By joining our team, you will be part of exciting work in developing geospatial datasets for catastrophe models, advancing AI\-powered geospatial analytics, and delivering innovative solutions in renewable energy intelligence, event response, and damage assessment to support global risk insights and decision\-making.
   

  

 Moody’s is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.
   

  

 Candidates for Moody's Corporation may be asked to disclose securities holdings pursuant to Moody’s Policy for Securities Trading and the requirements of the position. Employment is contingent upon compliance with the Policy, including remediation of positions in those holdings as necessary.
   

  

 For more information on the Securities Trading Program, please refer to the Securities Trading Policy on Moody’s Compliance Expo page
   

  

 Please note: STP categories are assigned by the hiring teams and are subject to change over the course of an employee’s tenure with Moody’s.

title: Security Control Assessment Specialist
description:
* Permanent \- Full Time
* Ahmedabad/GiftCity

We are seeking an experienced Security Control Assessment Specialist to independently test the design and operating effectiveness of Trading Technologies’ enterprise cybersecurity controls. This role plans and executes control assessments end to end, documents findings with clear supporting evidence, and partners with control owners and the TT Security team to design practical remediations. The role also contributes to the continuous improvement of the control environment itself, strengthening how controls are defined, evidenced and monitored, and automating control testing where possible.  

##### **Key Responsibilities**


* Plan and execute independent tests of enterprise cybersecurity controls across TT’s technology estate, with a high degree of autonomy over scoping, methodology, sampling and scheduling.
* Assess both the design and the operating effectiveness of controls, combining evidence review and control owner walkthroughs with hands\-on technical validation of configurations, logs, identity and access data, and cloud environments.
* Document findings clearly and defensibly, setting out the condition, criteria, cause, risk and impact, and rating them consistently against TT’s risk criteria.
* Partner with control owners and TT Security to design workable remediations, then validate closure through retesting rather than accepting assertion alone.
* Track findings and remediation plans through to closure, escalating overdue or inadequately addressed items where necessary.
* Build and maintain automated and continuous control monitoring so that control health is visible between formal assessment cycles.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of the control framework itself, refining control definitions, testing procedures, evidence requirements and the annual assessment plan.
* Map the control environment to SOC 2, ISO 27001 and NIST frameworks, identifying gaps, duplication and opportunities to test once and satisfy multiple obligations.
* Manage relationships with internal stakeholders and control owners, setting expectations, communicating requirements clearly, and holding a firm, evidence\-based position when findings are challenged.
* Support external audits and customer assessments by providing tested, reliable control evidence.
  

##### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**


Essential Skills \& Experience
* 8 to 10 years of IT experience, including at least 5 years focused on information security.
* Professional certification required: CISM, CISSP, CISA, CRISC or equivalent.
* Demonstrable experience designing and executing security control tests and producing findings and workpapers that withstand audit scrutiny.
* Strong working knowledge of cybersecurity controls and frameworks, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, the NIST Cybersecurity Framework and NIST SP 800\-53\.
* Technical depth across identity and access management, cloud infrastructure (AWS certification is a plus), endpoint and network security, logging and monitoring, vulnerability management and secure development practices.
* Experience automating control testing or building continuous control monitoring, using scripting, queries, APIs or GRC platform automation.
* Familiarity with GRC platforms such as OneTrust, Vanta, Drata, ServiceNow IRM or similar.
* Exceptional spoken and written English, with the ability to explain technical requirements and findings clearly to both engineers and senior stakeholders.
* Confidence and diplomacy to challenge control owners constructively and to hold a position under pressure when the evidence supports it.
* Ability to work autonomously, manage a portfolio of concurrent assessments and deliver to deadline with minimal supervision.
* Strong attention to detail and follow\-through.

Desirable Skills \& Experience
* Experience in financial services, capital markets or another regulated industry is highly regarded.
  

##### **Benefits**


**Compensation:**


***Competitive Benefits \& Perks in India*** *We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well\-being, growth, and work\-life balance.*
* **Health \& Financial Security:**
	+ Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage
* **Time Off \& Flexibility:**
	+ Enjoy the best of both worlds: the energy and collaboration of in\-person work, combined with the convenience and focus of remote days. This is a hybrid position requiring three days of in\-office collaboration per week, with the flexibility to work remotely for the remaining two days. Our hybrid model is designed to balance individual flexibility with the benefits of in\-person collaboration, enhanced team cohesion, spontaneous innovation, hands\-on mentorship opportunities and strengthens our company culture.
	+ 21 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, with the option to roll over unused days.

	+ Milestone anniversary bonuses.

	+ Subsidy contributions toward gym memberships and health/wellness initiatives.
* **Our Culture:**
	+ Forward\-thinking, culture\-based organization with collaborative teams that promote diversity and inclusion.

Trading Technologies (www.tradingtechnologies.com) is a global capital markets platform services company providing market\-leading technology for the end\-to\-end trading operations of Tier 1 banks, brokerages, money managers, hedge funds, proprietary traders, Commodity Trading Advisors (CTAs), commercial hedgers, and risk managers. With its roots in listed derivatives, the Software\-as\-a\-Service (SaaS) company delivers “multi\-X” solutions, with “X” representing asset classes, functions, workflows, and geographies. This multi\-X approach features trade execution services across futures and options, fixed income, foreign exchange (FX), and cryptocurrencies, augmented by solutions for data and analytics, including transaction cost analysis (TCA); quantitative trading; compliance and trade surveillance; clearing and post\-trade allocation; and infrastructure services. title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Kubogent
description:
**About Us**
 Aivar Innovations is an AI\-native services company and AWS Preferred Partner building governed, production\-grade agentic AI systems. We partner with enterprises to deploy intelligent agents that automate complex business processes—from intelligent customer interactions to enterprise knowledge systems.
   

  

**Experience: 4\-8 years \| Machine Learning, LLM Training, Inference \& MLOps**
**The Role**
 Kubogent is an AI/ML platform for teams that need to train, fine\-tune, deploy, and operate machine learning models across Kubernetes environments.
   

  

 We are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who can help turn real\-world ML workflows into reliable product capabilities inside Kubogent.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on engineering role. You will work across the model lifecycle \- from preparing data and training models to building reusable training jobs, inference workflows, experiment tracking, evaluation, and model lifecycle pipelines. You should be comfortable working directly with models and data, while also thinking about how those workflows should be exposed as repeatable, production\-grade platform capabilities for other teams to
   

  

 use.
   

  

 You will work closely with the engineers building Kubogent's Kubernetes, accelerator, scheduling, storage, observability, and platform layers. Your job is not only to train models, but to help define how training and inference should work as a product.
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

* Build Kubogent's model training capabilities. Design and implement reusable training and fine\-tuning workflows for different classes of machine learning models, including large language models.
* Build training\-job abstractions. Help define how users configure datasets, models, hyperparameters, compute requirements, checkpoints, outputs, and distributed training behavior, and translate those workflows into robust Kubogent training jobs.
* Build inference workflows. Work on model loading, serving, batching, runtime configuration, evaluation, scaling behavior, and performance characteristics for different model types and inference runtimes.
* Train and fine\-tune models. Perform hands\-on model development, training, fine\-tuning, evaluation, debugging, and iteration using modern machine learning frameworks and tooling.
* Own data preparation workflows. Work with raw datasets, understand data quality problems, clean and transform data, build preprocessing pipelines, create training/evaluation splits, and ensure datasets are reproducible and usable by downstream training jobs.
* Build MLOps pipelines. Implement repeatable workflows covering experimentation, training, evaluation, model registration, versioning, promotion, deployment, and rollback.
* Integrate experiment and model lifecycle tooling. Build integrations with tools such as MLflow for experiment tracking, metrics, artifacts, model metadata, model registries, and reproducibility.
* Evaluate models systematically. Define and implement evaluation pipelines, quality metrics, benchmark datasets, regression checks, and acceptance criteria appropriate to different model types.
* Improve training and inference efficiency. Investigate memory use, accelerator utilization, throughput, latency, batch sizing, precision, checkpointing, parallelism, and other factors that affect model performance and cost.
* Make ML workflows production\-grade. Handle failure recovery, checkpointing, reproducibility, observability, artifact management, configuration, and operational concerns that are often missing from notebook\-only workflows.
* Help shape the product. Work with the broader Kubogent team to decide which concepts should become APIs, workflows, defaults, templates, or reusable platform primitives rather than remaining one\-off scripts.


 What we're looking for
   

  

* 4\-8 years of relevant engineering experience, with substantial hands\-on work building and training machine learning systems.
* You have trained machine learning models yourself. You understand the practical workflow around datasets, preprocessing, experimentation, training, validation, evaluation, debugging, and iteration.
* Hands\-on experience training or fine\-tuning large language models. You understand tokenization, dataset preparation, training/fine\-tuning workflows, checkpoints, evaluation, and the practical constraints involved in working with LLMs.
* Strong data handling skills. You are comfortable taking imperfect real\-world data and performing cleaning, normalization, filtering, transformation, sampling, labeling or relabeling, dataset validation, and train/validation/test preparation.
* Strong Python skills and hands\-on experience with mainstream ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
* Experience with the modern LLM ecosystem, including libraries or frameworks such as Hugging Face Transformers and related model, tokenizer, dataset, and training tooling.
* Working experience with MLflow or comparable MLOps tooling. You understand experiment tracking, artifacts, parameters, metrics, model versioning, registries, and reproducible runs.
* You understand model inference beyond calling an API. You have worked with model serving or inference runtimes and understand concerns such as batching, latency, throughput, memory usage, model loading, precision, and accelerator constraints.
* You can build software around ML workflows. You are comfortable turning experimental code into maintainable libraries, services, jobs, pipelines, or platform components that other engineers can depend on.
* You understand reproducibility. You think about dataset versions, code versions, environments, configuration, seeds, checkpoints, artifacts, and the metadata required to reproduce a training run.
* You are comfortable debugging across layers. When a training or inference workload fails or performs poorly, you can reason about the model, data, framework, runtime, hardware, and surrounding system rather than treating them as isolated pieces.
* You communicate tradeoffs clearly. You can explain why a particular training method, evaluation strategy, serving runtime, precision, dataset choice, or optimization is appropriate instead of selecting tools by convention.


**Strong Pluses**
* Experience with distributed training technologies such as PyTorch Distributed, FSDP, DeepSpeed, Ray Train, or similar systems.
* Experience with parameter\-efficient fine\-tuning techniques such as LoRA or related approaches.
* Experience serving LLMs or other large models using runtimes such as vLLM, NVIDIA Triton, TensorRT\-LLM, TGI, or similar systems.
* Experience working directly with GPUs or other ML accelerators and understanding memory, utilization, mixed precision, multi\-device training, and performance bottlenecks.
* Experience running ML workloads on Kubernetes.
* Experience with workflow or pipeline systems used for ML workloads.
* Experience with large datasets and data\-processing technologies such as Pandas, Polars, PyArrow, Spark, or similar tools.
* Experience designing model evaluation, benchmark, safety, or regression pipelines.
* Experience working on an ML platform, developer platform, or internal tooling used by other ML engineers or data scientists.


 This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys both sides of machine learning engineering: working directly
   

  

 with models and data, and building the systems that make those workflows repeatable for everyone else

title: Senior AI/ Machine learning Engineer
description:
**1\. Role Overview**

We are seeking a Senior AI / Machine Learning Engineer to design and build systems that analyze points of interest (POIs) by extracting actionable insights from unstructured text, photos, and video media, and mapping them to dynamic user preferences and constraint\-aware recommendations. This is a hands\-on, execution\-driven role focused on multimodal feature extraction, location APIs, spatial graph reasoning, and personalized recommendation systems.

**2\. Key Responsibilities**

· **API \& Data Pipeline Engineering:** Design robust ETL/ELT pipelines to ingest, cache, normalize, and deduplicate point\-of\-interest data, metadata, customer reviews, and multimedia assets from third\-party APIs (such as Google Places API and open geospatial sources).

· **NLP \& Text Mining:** Build pipelines for aspect\-based sentiment analysis (ABSA), named entity extraction, and latent attribute mining across high\-volume, unstructured user reviews.

· **Computer Vision \& Video Analysis:** Implement models to process and score user\-submitted images and short video frames (aesthetic scoring, scene classification, crowd/atmosphere detection, and visual tag generation).

· **Multimodal Embedding \& Retrieval:** Align text, visual attributes, and spatial coordinates into unified vector spaces using modern multimodal architectures (e.g., CLIP, VLMs) to enable hybrid semantic search.

· **Personalization \& Routing Engines:** Build recommendation algorithms and constraint\-satisfaction solvers to rank, match, and sequence multi\-stop geographic routes based on user preferences and physical travel constraints.

· **Production Deployment \& Scale:** Containerize models, optimize inference latency and throughput, manage vector databases, and deploy production\-grade microservices.

**3\. Technical Requirements \& Skills Matrix**

**A. Machine Learning, NLP \& Multimodal AI**

· **Deep Learning Frameworks:** PyTorch or TensorFlow.

· **NLP \& LLMs:** Hugging Face Transformers, Sentence\-Transformers, spaCy, vLLM/Ollama, aspect\-based sentiment analysis, prompt orchestration.

· **Computer Vision:** OpenCV, PIL, CLIP/OpenCLIP, BLIP/LLaVA or equivalent Vision\-Language Models; practical experience in feature extraction, image tagging, and frame sampling from video (FFmpeg).

· **Vector Search \& Embeddings:** Hands\-on experience with vector databases (e.g., Qdrant, Milvus, Pinecone, or pgvector) and hybrid search (BM25 \+ dense retrieval).

**B. Geospatial \& Combinatorial Optimization**

· **Geospatial Processing:** Solid grasp of spatial indexing, distance metrics, and libraries such as GeoPandas, Shapely, OSMnx, or PostGIS.

· **API Integration:** Production experience consuming third\-party location platforms (Google Places API / Mapbox / Overpass API), including pagination, rate\-limit management, and caching strategies.

· **Constraint Optimization:** Familiarity with routing/scheduling algorithms, graph traversal (NetworkX), or constraint solvers (e.g., Google OR\-Tools, genetic algorithms, or heuristic search).

**C. Software Engineering \& Infrastructure**

· **Core Language:** Expert\-level Python (asynchronous programming, OOP, type hinting).

· **APIs \& Serving:** FastAPI, Flask, or gRPC; experience with task queues (Celery, Redis, or Ray).

· **Data Storage:** PostgreSQL, Redis, and object storage (S3 / GCS).

· **DevOps \& CI/CD:** Docker, basic Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud platform experience (AWS or GCP).

We are looking for individuals to join our team across all functional areas of our business – from sales to engineering, support functions to product development.
 



 Let’s build the future of mobile telecommunications together!
 



 About Rakuten Group, Inc. (TSE: 4755\) is a global leader in internet services that empower individuals, communities, businesses and society. Founded in Tokyo in 1997 as an online marketplace, Rakuten has expanded to offer services in e\-commerce, fintech, digital content and communications to 2 billion members around the world. The Rakuten Group has over 30,000 employees, and operations in 30 countries and regions. For more information visit https://global.rakuten.com/corp/.
 



  





**About the RIO Team**




 RIO (Rakuten Intelligent Operations) is Rakuten Symphony's AI\-first operational intelligence platform and the OSS engineering team behind it. RIO replaces fragmented OSS tooling with a single, intelligent control layer for complex, multi\-vendor telecom networks: unified real\-time observability across RAN, Core, Transport and Cloud; AI\-driven service assurance with anomaly detection, predictive analytics and proactive fault resolution; and closed\-loop, intent\-based automation.
 



  





**What Do We Expect From You**




 RIO's promise is AI\-native network operations. As a Senior AI Engineer on the AI Model \& Harness team, you will span two equally important halves: developing the ML models that detect anomalies, predict faults and localize root causes across telecom networks; and building the AI harness \- the training, evaluation, inference and monitoring infrastructure \- that takes those models from notebook to production with confidence. You will work directly on top of RIO's ClickHouse and YugabyteDB (YBSQL) data platforms, in tight partnership with the Data Management Pipelines team.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**




**ML Modeling (approximately 50%)** 



* **Anomaly detection:** 
 Develop and productionize multivariate time\-series anomaly detection models over network KPIs and counters to surface degraded cells and network elements before outages.
* **Predictive fault \& incident analysis:** 
 Build forecasting and classification models that predict faults and incidents ahead of failure, and correlate alarms across domains for root\-cause analysis and noise reduction.
* **Model portfolio:** 
 Own models across the operations lifecycle \- KPI forecasting, event correlation, root cause localization, capacity prediction and optimization \- from framing through production monitoring.
* **AI\-defined KPIs:** 
 Move beyond vendor KPI formulas by learning leading/lagging indicators directly from raw counters, surfacing signals humans and rule\-based systems miss.



  





**AI Harness \& Inference Infrastructure (approximately 50%)** 




  




* **Training \& experimentation:** 
 Build reproducible training, experiment\-tracking and hyperparameter\-tuning workflows over large\-scale telemetry datasets drawn from ClickHouse/YBSQL.
* **Evaluation frameworks:** 
 Design rigorous offline and online evaluation (backtesting, precision/recall on incident ground truth, A/B and shadow deployments) so every model's operational impact is measurable.
* **Serving \& inference pipelines:** 
 Deploy low\-latency, high\-availability inference services with canary/rollback strategies; implement batch and streaming inference over near\-real\-time pipeline data.
* **Monitoring \& lifecycle:** 
 Own model observability \- drift detection, data\-quality gates, alerting on degradation \- and automated retraining/evaluation loops.
* **LLM \& agentic AI:** 
 Contribute guard\-railed LLM\-based capabilities such as RAG over fault manuals and specifications, natural\-language intent interfaces and LLM\-assisted root\-cause analysis.
* **Partnership with data pipelines:** 
 Define feature and training\-data contracts with the Data Management Pipelines team; ensure models consume and produce data through governed, well\-modeled interfaces.
* **Operational excellence:** 
 Participate in on\-call for AI services; own the reliability of everything the harness runs in production.



  





**Required Qualifications**
 :
 


* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 6\+ years of experience in ML/AI engineering, including production deployment of models on live, high\-volume data.
* Hands\-on experience developing time\-series ML models (anomaly detection, forecasting or classification) \- deep learning and classical \- with real operational impact.
* Experience building ML infrastructure: training pipelines, evaluation frameworks, feature handling, model serving and monitoring (frameworks such as PyTorch, scikit\-learn, XGBoost/LightGBM; MLOps tooling such as MLflow, Kubeflow or equivalent).
* Strong Python engineering; comfortable with large datasets via SQL (ClickHouse/YugabyteDB/PostgreSQL experience a plus).
* Solid software engineering fundamentals \- version control, testing, CI/CD, containerization, Kubernetes.
* Ability to own problems end\-to\-end: from ambiguous operational question to productionized, monitored model.



  





**Preferred Qualifications:**



* Domain experience in telecom OSS, network operations, or AIOps \- e.g., KPI anomaly detection, alarm correlation, root cause analysis on network telemetry.
* Experience with LLM applications in production: RAG pipelines, prompt/eval harnesses, guard\-railed agent orchestration.
* Familiarity with streaming/data platforms: Kafka, Flink/Spark, ClickHouse, or YugabyteDB.
* Experience with online evaluation, shadow deployments and human\-in\-the\-loop feedback loops.
* Public contributions to ML/AIOps research or open source (papers, repos, talks).

 :**

* **Always improve, always advance.**

title: Modeling Technical Lead Engineer
description:
**The impact you’ll make**
 As a leading global supplier of wafer fabrication equipment and services to the semiconductor industry, Lam Research develops innovative solutions that help our customers build smaller, faster, and more power\-efficient devices. We create equipment that allows chipmakers to build device features more than 1,000 times smaller than a grain of sand. This tiny scale has a huge impact. Virtually every leading\-edge chip inside the electronic products you use every day (TVs, smartphones, laptops, cars—even medical devices) has been made using our equipment.
   

  

 We are a company comprised of people who work hard, deliver outstanding results, and maintain a sense of humor during even the most challenging times. Our success results from our employees' diverse technical and business expertise, which fuels close collaboration and ongoing innovation. We know that our dynamic, global team of exceptional employees is essential to our continued growth.
   

  

 As one of the world’s most trusted suppliers in the semiconductor equipment industry, we’re transforming technology. Our equipment places atoms so precisely that nearly every chip today is made using our innovations. Such cutting\-edge innovations require the need to develop physics\-based models appropriately capturing the phenomena relevant at nanometer and atomistic scales.
   

  

 Join the Lam Research team, where you can walk the path historically driven by Moore’s law and play a vital role in the future of electronics to write your own success story.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
 This position will be based out of Bangalore in LIGHT (Lam India Global Hardware Team) modelling group closely working with Local and Global Product Groups. This individual would be responsible for simulating complex multi physics problems to aid product or process development by working closely with engineering teams in the US, Europe and Asia region. We are looking for a talented self\-motivated individual who will have following primary job responsibilities:
   

  

* Conceptualize and build atomistic or phenomenological models to study transport of multispecies gas and/or liquid media in confined channels
* Wherever applicable, implement the chemical reaction kinetics along with transport to simulate etch, dep or clean processes relevant for semiconductor industry
* Wherever applicable, collaborate with other modelling engineers working on continuum\-based methods for seamless transfer of boundary conditions to atomistic models
* Collaborate effectively with engineers from various Business Units to translate their problem statements into a modelling scope followed by execution and efficient delivery of results
* Report out the outcomes of modelling studies in the form of a document to Product Development teams
* Establish new modelling protocols and publish them as Best Known Methods


**Mandatory Skills Required To Perform The Job**
* Strong expertise in molecular modeling, specifically molecular dynamics and Monte Carlo based approaches
* Strong hold on languages (for e.g. python) for post\-processing of results involving large data sets
* Knowledge of developing new or implementing existing ML\-based forcefields to account for new interatomic interactions and chemistries (using reactive force fields)
* Knowledge of AI/ML based approaches to accelerate MD simulations for probing larger length and time scales
* Engineering judgment and creativity to solve complex problems with right trade\-off between accuracy and time\-to\-delivery.
* Good communication and documentation skills for effective project delivery with global teams
* High learning agility to quickly pick up product knowledge, domain knowledge and software tool expertise to model high fidelity multi physics complex models
* Strong interpersonal skills to build effective relationships with local and global stakeholders to be successful in a matrix organization
* Proficiency in using softwares like LAMMPS, Quantum Espresso, Jaguar, Gaussian, Amber, etc.

title: Network Architect
description:

We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in\-person channels.

Candescent is seeking an experienced and innovative **Network Architect** to lead the design, strategy, and evolution of our enterprise network infrastructure. This role is responsible for developing scalable, secure, and resilient network architectures that support corporate offices, cloud environments, financial institution operations, and emerging business initiatives.


The Network Architect will partner closely with Infrastructure, Security, Cloud Engineering, Application Development, and Operations teams to define technology roadmaps, establish engineering standards, and drive modernization initiatives. **Enterprise Network Architecture**

* Lead technology evaluations, proof\-of\-concepts, and vendor assessments.
* Develop multi\-year network technology roadmaps and lifecycle management strategies.

* Review network performance, capacity, resiliency, and availability metrics.

**Automation \& Modernization**

* Promote network automation and orchestration strategies.
* Design solutions utilizing APIs, scripting, and infrastructure\-as\-code platforms.
* Drive adoption of modern operational models and observability platforms.
* Partner with engineering teams to implement automated provisioning and configuration management.

**Mentorship \& Collaboration**

* Mentor Network Engineers and Senior Engineers on architecture and design principles.
* Participate in technical reviews, change advisory boards, and project governance.
* Foster technical excellence across Infrastructure Engineering teams.
* Build strong partnerships with business units, application owners, vendors, and managed service providers.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline.
* 10\+ years of enterprise networking experience.
* 5\+ years designing large\-scale, mission\-critical network environments.
* Expert level experience with:
	+ GCP Networking
	+ Cloud and B2B Networking
	+ Palo Alto Networks firewalls
	+ Meraki Wireless networking technologies
	+ SD\-WAN solutions
* Strong experience designing:
	+ Fortigate Network firewalls
	+ Corporate office networks
	+ Hybrid cloud connectivity
	+ Individual Financial Institution Networks
* Experience with network security architecture and segmentation strategies.
* Proven ability to lead large\-scale infrastructure transformation projects.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Financial services or regulated industry experience.
* Experience with:
	+ Cisco Wireless / Meraki
	+ Palo Alto Networks \& SCM
	+ Azure networking
	+ AWS networking
	+ GCP networking (Must Have)
	+ Prisma Access
	+ Network automation platforms
* Knowledge of infrastructure\-as\-code frameworks.
* Experience with monitoring and observability platforms.
* Strong written documentation and presentation skills.

**Certifications (Nice To Have)**

* Palo Alto Networks Certified Network Security Architect (PCNSA/PCNSE)
* Professional Cloud Network Engineer (PCNE)
* AWS Advanced Networking Specialty
* Microsoft Azure Network Engineer Associate
* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)

**Success Metrics**


The successful Network Architect will:

* Establish enterprise architecture standards and governance.
* Improve network reliability, resiliency, and security posture.
* Reduce operational complexity through standardization and automation.
* Lead infrastructure modernization initiatives.
* Support business growth through scalable network design.
* Serve as the trusted technical advisor for network strategy across Candescent.

Backed by top\-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve **raised** **$31\.8M** in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over **4,000 organizations across 75 countries**, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit\-ready, manage real\-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With **300\+ native integrations** and AI\-driven automation, Sprinto supports **200\+ global security standards natively**, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI\-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.


**Founded in 2020** by second\-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.


### **Life as a Sprinter \-**



Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.



We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.



Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction.



We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.



And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.


### **The mission \-**



We're hiring a **Partnership Manager** to build and scale Sprinto's partner ecosystem. This role is about creating long\-term revenue through strategic partnerships, not just managing existing relationships.



You'll identify, recruit, and enable consulting firms, channel partners, resellers, system integrators, and managed service providers who can take Sprinto to new customers and markets. From building the partner pipeline to driving joint go\-to\-market initiatives and co\-selling opportunities, you'll own the partner journey end to end.



We're looking for someone who understands that successful partnerships are built on mutual growth. Someone who can influence senior stakeholders, create repeatable partner programs, and turn relationships into predictable pipeline and revenue.



### **Where you'll leave your mark?**


* Build and scale Sprinto's partner ecosystem by recruiting consulting firms, MSPs, MSSPs, system integrators, resellers, and channel partners
* Own the end\-to\-end partner lifecycle, from prospecting and qualification to onboarding, enablement, and long\-term success
* Design and execute joint go\-to\-market strategies, including co\-selling, co\-marketing, and partner\-led growth initiatives
* Develop partner enablement assets, business plans, sales collateral, and value proposition decks to help partners sell Sprinto effectively
* Partner closely with Sales teams on strategic opportunities and participate in customer conversations alongside partners
* Track partner health through pipeline generation, deal registrations, win rates, deal velocity, and overall revenue contribution
* Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to align on business goals, performance, and growth opportunities
* Own partner operations, including CRM and PRM hygiene, partner tiering, deal registration processes, and reporting
* Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success teams to launch partner programs and campaigns that accelerate growth
### **The kind of builder we're looking for \-**


* 5–8 years of overall experience, including 3\+ years in SaaS partnerships, alliances, channel sales, or ecosystem roles
* Must have recent experience building and scaling partner programs across US.
* Strong understanding of partner\-led GTM motions, channel sales, and indirect revenue models
* Proven ability to recruit, enable, and grow strategic partners that contribute measurable pipeline and revenue
* Strong commercial acumen with experience supporting or participating in enterprise sales cycles
* Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship\-building skills across executive and operational stakeholders
* Experience working cross\-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success teams
* Highly organized, self\-driven, and comfortable operating in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment

#### **This Role Is Ideal For Someone Who**


* Enjoys building partnerships from scratch instead of simply managing existing accounts
* Thinks beyond partner recruitment and focuses on long\-term partner success and revenue generation
* Can balance strategic relationship\-building with operational excellence
* Loves collaborating across teams to create scalable GTM programs
* Is energized by building new markets and expanding partner ecosystems
* Measures success by partner\-generated pipeline, revenue, and long\-term business impact


### **How we care for our Sprinters?**


* **Co\-working, on the house**: If co\-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance.
* **We care about your learning**: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills.
* **We count your spark, not your leaves**: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to.
* **Your Safety Net, Woven In:** Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary.
* **Workspace setup of your dreams**: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you.


### **Inclusion \& Diversity \-**



At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.



We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.



We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Lead Analyst
description:
**Payments \& Cards SME Lead – Disputes Management**
====================================================

### **Role Overview**


We are looking for a **Payments \& Cards SME Lead** with strong hands\-on expertise in **banking, card payments, and dispute management** to drive the design and development of an end\-to\-end **Disputes Management lifecycle**.
The ideal candidate will bring deep functional knowledge of **Visa and Mastercard dispute processes, payment network APIs, card transaction flows, payment codes, and industry standards**, and will work closely with product, engineering, and client teams to translate payment\-domain requirements into scalable technology solutions.### **Key Responsibilities**

* Own the **payments and cards domain expertise** for the Disputes Management platform.
* Define and validate the **end\-to\-end card dispute lifecycle**, including:
	+ Dispute initiation
	+ Classification and reason\-code mapping
	+ Documentation and evidence validation
	+ Representment
	+ Pre\-arbitration / arbitration
	+ Network submission
	+ Network responses and rejects
	+ Final resolution and closure
* Provide functional expertise for **Visa and Mastercard dispute processes and integrations**.
* Guide engineering teams on **Visa and Mastercard API integrations**, including request/response structures, validations, error handling, status management, and network\-specific workflows.
* Translate network rules and payment\-domain requirements into **product requirements, business rules, workflows, and acceptance criteria**.
* Provide expertise on **card transaction lifecycle, authorization, clearing, settlement, chargebacks and disputes**.
* Ensure correct interpretation and usage of **ISO payment/message codes, card transaction codes, dispute reason codes and network\-specific codes**.
* Provide guidance on **PCI DSS** requirements and ensure relevant payment\-data handling considerations are incorporated into the solution.
* Work with architects and developers to identify domain and integration dependencies across **banks, processors, card networks and payment systems**.
* Review and validate dispute workflows, API specifications, business rules and solution designs from a payments\-domain perspective.
* Support analysis of **network responses, rejects, exceptions and edge cases** and help define appropriate system handling.
* Stay current with changes in **Visa/Mastercard rules, dispute regulations, APIs and payment industry standards**.
* Act as the primary **Payments SME** for client discussions, requirement workshops, solution walkthroughs and domain\-level clarifications.
* Mentor product managers, business analysts and engineering teams on **cards, payments and disputes**.

### **Required Skills \& Experience**

* **Minimum 3 years of hands\-on experience in Cards \& Payments**, preferably within banking, payment processing, card networks or fintech.
* Strong understanding of the **end\-to\-end card payments lifecycle**.
* Practical experience working with **Visa and Mastercard** payment/dispute processes.
* Experience with **Visa and Mastercard APIs or network integrations**.
* Strong understanding of **card disputes / chargebacks and the dispute lifecycle**.
* Knowledge of **representment, pre\-arbitration, arbitration, dispute reason codes and evidence requirements**.
* Good understanding of **ISO payment/message codes and card/payment transaction codes**.
* Working knowledge of **PCI DSS** and secure handling of card/payment data.
* Experience translating business/payment\-network requirements into **functional requirements and technical specifications**.
* Ability to work closely with **engineering, architecture, product, QA and client teams**.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to understand complex payment scenarios and exceptions.

### **Good to Have**

* Experience working with **banking processors, card issuers, acquirers or payment service providers**.
* Experience with **Visa Claims Resolution (VCR)** and/or Mastercard dispute frameworks.
* Exposure to **ISO 8583** and card transaction messaging.
* Experience with payment gateways, processors or core banking/card processing platforms.
* Experience working on **AI/automation\-driven dispute management or payment operations**.
* Knowledge of regulatory and compliance considerations in card payments.
* Experience in Agile product development and working with distributed engineering teams.

### **Key Success Measures**


The SME will be expected to:* Establish accurate **end\-to\-end payment and dispute workflows**.
* Reduce ambiguity between **network rules, business requirements and technical implementation**.
* Ensure Visa/Mastercard integrations correctly handle **happy paths, exceptions and network responses**.
* Enable engineering teams to build a **compliant, scalable and production\-ready Disputes Management platform**.
* Serve as the **go\-to Cards \& Payments authority** for the product and delivery teams.

### **Preferred Profile**

**Cards \& Payments SME \| Disputes \& Chargebacks \| Visa \& Mastercard \| Network APIs \| PCI DSS \| ISO 8583 / Payment Codes \| Banking \| Payment Processing**

description:
**Role Purpose**

The Application Development Senior Analyst designs, builds, tests and supports secure, reliable digital solutions that meet business and customer needs. * Experience working in Agile teams and managing work through tools such as Jira and Confluence or equivalent.
* Experience with code review, automated testing and CI/CD pipelines.
* Ability to communicate technical information clearly to engineering and non\-engineering stakeholders.
* Sound judgement, attention to detail, ownership and a continuous\-learning mindset.
* Ability to balance delivery pace with quality, security, maintainability and operational support needs.

**Role\-Specific Technical Skills**
-----------------------------------

* Salesforce platform development and configuration, including Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL and platform security concepts.

----------------

* Relevant platform certification or equivalent demonstrable experience.
* Experience in healthcare, insurance or another regulated industry.
* Experience with SAFe or delivery across multiple dependent teams.
* Awareness of accessibility, performance engineering and resilient integration design.
* Experience using approved AI\-assisted development tools to support activities such as code generation, refactoring, unit\-test creation, documentation, debugging or code explanation, while applying human review, secure\-coding practices and data\-handling controls.
* Experience using approved generative AI tools in day\-to\-day work to summarise information, improve written communication, prepare meeting outputs, explore options or streamline repeatable tasks, with appropriate validation of outputs.
* An interest in evaluating AI use cases based on measurable value, quality, risk and responsible\-use considerations.

**What Good Performance Looks Like**
------------------------------------

**Delivery:** Completes agreed work predictably, surfaces risks early and follows through to a stable outcome.

**Engineering quality:** Produces maintainable, tested and secure solutions that meet agreed standards.

**Ownership:** Handles moderately complex work with limited oversight and takes responsibility for follow\-up.

**Collaboration:** Works constructively across disciplines, contributes to reviews and shares knowledge.

**Improvement:** Identifies practical ways to reduce rework, strengthen controls and improve team effectiveness.

**Responsible AI use:** Uses AI as an assistive tool where permitted, validates outputs and never substitutes generated content for engineering accountability.

**Education and Professional Development**
------------------------------------------


Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.


Commitment to ongoing technical learning, including platform, security, cloud, automation and responsible AI capabilities relevant to the role.

### **Required Qualifications**


* A minimum of 5 years of experience administering enterprise Human Resources applications, with hands\-on UKG Pro (formerly UltiPro) experience as the primary qualification.

* Experience managing security roles, permissions, and access controls within an HRIS platform.
* Experience building and maintaining business process workflows, approval chains, and notifications.
* Experience supporting integrations between HR systems and other enterprise applications.
* Experience with system testing, including validating configuration changes and vendor releases prior to production deployment.
* Experience monitoring and maintaining data quality and data integrity across HR systems.
* Experience building reports and dashboards to support HR and business reporting needs.
* Strong documentation skills, with the ability to maintain clear and current process and configuration documentation.

title: External Data Services Manager
description:
External Data Services Manager  

  

ICON is a global healthcare intelligence and clinical research organisation united by a mission to bring new medicines and treatments to patients faster.

  

  

As a values\-driven organisation, integrity, collaboration, agility, and inclusion are at the heart of how we work and interact with each other, customers, patients and suppliers.

  

  

Job Advert Posting
As an External Data Services Manager at ICON, you will be instrumental in leading the development and implementation of advanced data science solutions for clinical trials.


**What You Will Do:**

You will manage day\-to\-day clinical data science activities, supporting your team to deliver quality outcomes.
  

  

**Key responsibilities include:**

* Lead the development of Data Transfer Specifications (DTS) documents to align external data providers and research partners on the required structure for new data. This includes:
* Authoring the DTS, responding to external data providers and internal stakeholder queries to ensure
* data will be delivered in the correct format and structure.
* Track DTS status with external data providers across different data types and programs and ensure data completion dates are met for study timelines and deliverables.
* Ensuring data structure based on the type(s) of data being used is consistent and compliant with appropriate data templates.
* Ensuring data structure is consistent across each data provider and comply with appropriate data templates.
* Support data reconciliation and data structure inquiry resolution.
* Liaise cross functionally to facilitate the creation of new test codes.
* Participate in the Clinical Study Team as an extended team member.
* Oversee and train in the use of the DTS and other supplemental documents.
* Contribute to improvement initiatives as it relates to external data process.
* Ensure study teams adhere to CDISC standards as it relates to external data.
* Comply with all pertinent regulatory agency requirements (Understand clinical protocols and requirement for Biomarkers/Imaging/eCOA data, blinding and analysis expectations).
* Process change requests to update existing DTS.
* Improve templates for existing DTS to ensure data harmonization and downstream analytics.
* Provide external data management oversight to vendors, providing a pathway for functional discussions, partnership level processes \& standards, portfolio status, communication, and escalation.
* Review and contribute to eCRF and EDC builds as it relates to external data requirements.

**Your Profile:**

You will have solid clinical data science experience, with the ability to manage competing priorities and develop your team.
  

  

**Required qualifications and experience:**

* Minimum 8\+ years of experience in external data services
* Expertise in biomarker data types and/or Imaging data for oncology and non\-oncology studies is preferred
* Experience working with multiple data types/formats
* Experience in managing clinical, biomarker data, eCOA and imaging data
* Demonstrates broad knowledge of all applicable regulations including 21 CFR
* Part 11, ICH\-GCP Guidelines and CDISC standards for data collections.
* Demonstrates advanced knowledge of Data Management processes and industry best practices.
* Advanced knowledge and experience with extracting data into SAS, CSV, and
* XML formats is required.
  

Employment with ICON is contingent upon having the legal right to work in the country where the role is based.

  

  

**Rewards \& Benefits**

ICON offers a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package designed to support your health, wellbeing, and career development.

  

  

Benefits may include:


* Competitive base salary and performance related incentives
* Health and wellbeing programmes including medical, dental, and vision coverage where applicable
* Retirement and pension plans
* Life assurance and disability coverage
* Employee assistance programmes and wellbeing resources
* Learning and development opportunities through structured training and career pathways
  

  

Benefits may vary depending on role and location.

  

  

Visit our careers site to read more about the benefits ICON offers.

  

  

**Inclusion and Accessibility**

ICON is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive and accessible workplace where everyone feels valued and supported.

  

  

If you require reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know or submit a **request** .

title: Amazon Marketplace Specialist – E-Commerce
description:
Sportstech is looking for an experienced and hands\-on **Amazon Marketplace Specialist** to manage and optimize our product listings across Amazon and other major European marketplaces.

You will take ownership of Amazon listings—from creating complex product variations and optimizing product content to resolving suppressed listings, blocked ASINs, catalogue conflicts, and account\-health issues.

You will also work closely with account managers and internal teams, participate in regular meetings, prepare performance reports, and use AI tools to improve marketplace workflows and team efficiency.

This position is ideal for someone with strong practical Amazon experience who knows how to respond when a listing breaks, a product is suppressed, or an ASIN is blocked.

Key ResponsibilitiesAmazon Listing Management

* Create, maintain, and optimize product listings through Amazon Seller Central and Vendor Central.
* Build complex listings, including parent\-child variations for sizes, colours, and bundles.
* Create and manage A\+ Content, Enhanced Brand Content, and Amazon Brand Store pages.
* Maintain the quality of product titles, bullet points, descriptions, backend keywords, images, and attributes.
* Conduct keyword research and continuously optimize listings for search visibility and conversion.
* Manage bulk product uploads using flat files and inventory templates.

Problem Resolution and Account Health

* Independently resolve suppressed listings, blocked or locked ASINs, category errors, attribute issues, hijacked listings, and content disputes.
* Open, manage, follow up, and escalate cases with Amazon Seller Support until they are fully resolved.
* Monitor account\-health metrics and proactively prevent policy violations.
* Handle catalogue conflicts, Brand Registry issues, and compliance\-documentation requests.

Multi\-Platform Marketplace Management

* Support listing creation and maintenance across European marketplaces such as Otto, Kaufland, Decathlon, and MediaMarkt/Saturn.
* Adapt product content and data according to each marketplace’s requirements.
* Investigate and resolve platform\-specific listing and catalogue issues.

Reporting and Sales Analysis

* Prepare and maintain sales and marketplace performance reports.
* Analyse sales, traffic, conversion rates, Buy Box performance, and product rankings.
* Identify trends, risks, and opportunities and provide actionable recommendations.
* Work confidently with Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, data cleaning, and large datasets.

Communication and Collaboration

* Communicate proactively and professionally with account managers and internal teams.
* Participate actively in regular team meetings and video calls.
* Document marketplace processes, issues, and solutions in a structured and transparent manner.

AI\-Supported Workflows

Using modern AI tools as part of daily marketplace operations is an important requirement for this position.

* Use Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, or similar AI tools for listing creation, translation, keyword research, case communication, data analysis, and workflow automation.
* Stay updated on new AI tools and marketplace technologies.
* Proactively recommend ways to improve team productivity and operational efficiency through AI.

Required Qualifications

* At least 2–5 years of professional experience as an Amazon Specialist, Marketplace Manager, or in a comparable role.
* Strong hands\-on knowledge of Amazon Seller Central; Vendor Central experience is preferred.
* Proven experience creating complex Amazon listings, parent\-child variations, A\+ Content, and flat\-file uploads.

description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.



This Position reports to:



Senior Engineering Manager \#\#\#



In this role, you will have the opportunity to lead and support engineering activities in all types of project sizes and complexities. Each day, you will complete the tasks cost\-effectively and in accordance with contract specifications, quality standards, safety requirements, and cybersecurity policies and standards. You will also highlight your expertise by collecting data and supporting production of engineering design.



The work model for the role is \# LI \- Hybrid.



This role is contributing to the to the Process Automation business in Energy Industries division based in Bangalore, India.


**You will be mainly accountable for:**


* Engineering, testing, commissioning, and lifecycle support of Power Management Systems (PMS), including load shedding, load sharing, synchronization, and monitoring/control of primary electrical equipment.
* Designing, developing, and integrating DCS/SCADA solutions, including controller configuration, application engineering, HMI development, graphics creation, and system software implementation.
* Developing and implementing power system control philosophies, ensuring reliable and efficient operation of industrial power and automation systems.
* Configuring and integrating IEDs, protection relays, protocol gateways, and data concentrators, including management of IEC 61850 engineering files (ICD, CID, and SCD).
* Designing and maintaining industrial control system network architectures, ensuring robust communication between field devices, controllers, and enterprise systems.
* Implementing and troubleshooting industrial communication protocols such as IEC 61850, Modbus, OPC, DNP3, IEC 101/104, TCP/IP, Profinet, and Fieldbus.
* Executing FAT, IFAT, SAT, and commissioning activities, while preparing and maintaining engineering documentation from basic design through detailed engineering stages.
* Supporting OT/IT integration, industrial cybersecurity, system maintenance, backup strategies, and asset performance improvement initiatives, including renewable energy and asset reliability solutions where applicable.


You will join a talented team, where you will be able to thrive.


**Qualifications for the role:**


* Minimum 15\&\#43; years of experience in Power Management Systems (PMS), Power Systems, Substation Automation, DCS/SCADA engineering, or a related industrial automation domain, including experience in planning and project execution roles.
* Proven experience in providing technical solutions, engineering leadership, and system integration expertise for complex industrial, utility, or energy sector projects.
* Demonstrated people management and project management experience, with the ability to lead multidisciplinary engineering teams and drive project delivery.
* Strong experience in executing international and domestic projects, including engineering, testing, commissioning, customer coordination, and site support activities.
* Sound understanding of power systems, industrial automation, communication networks, and control system architectures, with the ability to manage technical and commercial project requirements.
* Excellent verbal and written communication, stakeholder management, and customer\-facing skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate across global teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Automation, or a related Engineering discipline.
* Willingness to travel 30\-50% nationally and internationally as required for project execution, commissioning, customer engagements, and business support activities. A valid international passport is mandatory.


**More about us**



ABB a provides a comprehensive range of integrated automation, electrical and digital systems and services for customers in the process, hybrid and maritime industries. These offerings, coupled with deep domain knowledge in each end market, help to optimize productivity, energy efficiency, sustainability and safety of industrial processes and operations.



The Energy Industries Division serves a wide range of industrial sectors, including hydrocarbons, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, power generation and water. With its integrated solutions that automate, digitalize and electrify operations, the Division is committed to supporting traditional industries in their efforts to decarbonize. The Division also supports the development, integration and scaling up of new and renewable energy models. The Division’s goal is to help customers adapt and succeed in the rapidly changing global energy transition. Harnessing data, machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI), the Division brings over 50 years of domain expertise delivering solutions designed to improve energy, process and production efficiency, as well as reduce risk, operational cost and capital cost, while minimizing waste for customers, from project start\-up and throughout the entire plant lifecycle.



Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

description:
Candescent is a forward\-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in\-person channels.


Our Experience\-Led, Intelligence\-Driven approach combines human\-centered design with data, automation, and cloud\-based innovation. Built on an API\-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.

**Position Summary**


Candescent is seeking an experienced and innovative **Network Architect** to lead the design, strategy, and evolution of our enterprise network infrastructure. This role is responsible for developing scalable, secure, and resilient network architectures that support corporate offices, cloud environments, financial institution operations, and emerging business initiatives.


The Network Architect will partner closely with Infrastructure, Security, Cloud Engineering, Application Development, and Operations teams to define technology roadmaps, establish engineering standards, and drive modernization initiatives. This position serves as the highest level of technical authority for enterprise networking and provides guidance for complex projects, strategic investments, and operational excellence.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Enterprise Network Architecture**

* Develop and maintain the enterprise network architecture roadmap.
* Design highly available, scalable, and secure LAN, WAN, WLAN, SD\-WAN, Cloud and B2B Networking and internet edge solutions.
* Create and maintain high\-level and low\-level network designs, standards, and reference architectures.
* Evaluate existing environments and recommend improvements aligned with business objectives.
* Establish networking standards and governance for all Candescent locations and hosted environments.

**Cloud \& Hybrid Networking**

* Design connectivity solutions for Azure, AWS,GCP (Must Have) and hybrid cloud deployments.
* Define architectures for cloud transit networking, DNS, routing, security segmentation, and application delivery.
* Lead cloud networking initiatives on secure multi\-cloud connectivity.
* Collaborate with cloud engineering teams on network automation and infrastructure\-as\-code initiatives.

**Security Architecture \& Compliance**

* Partner with Information Security teams to design secure network solutions.
* Develop architectures supporting Zero Trust, network segmentation, NAC, SASE, ZTNA, and secure remote access.
* Ensure designs meet regulatory and compliance requirements including FFIEC, PCI\-DSS, SOX, and corporate security standards.
* Provide technical leadership during security assessments, audits, and risk reviews.

**Strategic Leadership**

* Provide architectural oversight for major infrastructure projects.
* Lead technology evaluations, proof\-of\-concepts, and vendor assessments.
* Develop multi\-year network technology roadmaps and lifecycle management strategies.
* Influence infrastructure direction through innovation and industry best practices.
* Present architectural recommendations to senior leadership and executive stakeholders.

**Operational Excellence**

* Act as the highest escalation point for complex networking issues.
* Review network performance, capacity, resiliency, and availability metrics.
* Guide disaster recovery and business continuity planning efforts.
* Ensure infrastructure designs align with operational supportability requirements.

**Automation \& Modernization**

* Promote network automation and orchestration strategies.
* Design solutions utilizing APIs, scripting, and infrastructure\-as\-code platforms.
* Drive adoption of modern operational models and observability platforms.
* Partner with engineering teams to implement automated provisioning and configuration management.

**Mentorship \& Collaboration**

* Mentor Network Engineers and Senior Engineers on architecture and design principles.
* Participate in technical reviews, change advisory boards, and project governance.
* Foster technical excellence across Infrastructure Engineering teams.
* Build strong partnerships with business units, application owners, vendors, and managed service providers.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline.
* 10\+ years of enterprise networking experience.
* 5\+ years designing large\-scale, mission\-critical network environments.
* Expert level experience with:
	+ GCP Networking
	+ Cloud and B2B Networking
	+ Palo Alto Networks firewalls
	+ Meraki Wireless networking technologies
	+ SD\-WAN solutions
* Strong experience designing:
	+ Fortigate Network firewalls
	+ Corporate office networks
	+ Hybrid cloud connectivity
	+ Individual Financial Institution Networks
* Experience with network security architecture and segmentation strategies.
* Proven ability to lead large\-scale infrastructure transformation projects.

**Preferred Qualifications**

	+ Cisco Wireless / Meraki
	+ Palo Alto Networks \& SCM
	+ Azure networking
	+ AWS networking
	+ GCP networking (Must Have)
	+ Prisma Access
	+ Network automation platforms

* Experience with monitoring and observability platforms.
* Strong written documentation and presentation skills.

* Professional Cloud Network Engineer (PCNE)
* AWS Advanced Networking Specialty
* Microsoft Azure Network Engineer Associate

**Success Metrics**

* Improve network reliability, resiliency, and security posture.

* Lead infrastructure modernization initiatives.
* Support business growth through scalable network design.

description:

We are the preferred choice of 900\+ global enterprises to manage their 2\.5 million\+ employees across 116\+ countries.

**Role Overview:**


As the Executive Assistant, you will provide high\-touch, directed and timely support to the SVP – APMEA (Asia Pacific, Middle East \& Africa) and his leadership team, acting as a trusted partner who keeps communications, calendars, travel, meetings, and day\-to\-day logistics running seamlessly. You will be the organizational anchor that enables leadership to focus on strategic priorities while you manage the flow of information, stakeholders, and customer engagements across the APMEA organization – spanning SEA, India, Middle East and Africa – with professionalism, absolute confidentiality, and a technology\-forward, AI\-enabled approach to executive support.

  

**Reporting Relationships:**


**Reports to:** SVP – APMEA (Asia Pacific, Middle East \& Africa)


**Geographic scope:** Coordination across SEA, India, and Middle East \& Africa as part of the APMEA organization


**Team:** Works closely with APMEA leadership team, cross\-functional leaders/teams, internal stakeholders, customers, and external partners across regions

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Support to leadership –** Provide support to the SVP – APMEA and APMEA leadership team in a directed and timely manner to achieve organizational goals and accomplish objectives.
* **Stakeholder liaison –** Liaise with internal and external stakeholders to manage communication on various projects and tasks.

* **Reports \& documentation –** Prepare reports, presentations, and data, and maintain files, records, and correspondence for meetings.
