* **Meeting minutes –** Record minutes of meetings whenever required to support the SVP and the leadership team.
* **Customer \& visitor management –** Manage customer visits and delegates across the region to ensure every visit is handled smoothly.
* **Interpersonal effectiveness –** Interact with ease with fellow team members and other stakeholders, and deliver essential results through effective communication.
* **Cross\-functional collaboration –** Contribute to cross\-functional teams to accomplish results as needed.
* **APMEA coordination –** Coordinate across SEA, India, and Middle East \& Africa as part of the APMEA organization, managing time zones, travel, and communications across the region.
* **AI initiatives –** Drive and support AI initiatives for the leadership office: use AI tools to automate workflows, draft and summarize communications, build meeting intelligence, and streamline reporting, while championing AI adoption in administrative processes.
* **AI productivity enablement –** Leverage AI assistants and automation (e.g., scheduling, transcription, document generation, data synthesis) to improve the speed and quality of executive support, and help the broader EA/administrative community adopt these practices.
  

  

**Skills \& Qualifications**

* **English fluency (mandatory) –** Strong communication skills with English fluency required; additional regional languages are a plus.

* **Executive support experience –** 10\+ years of proven experience as an executive assistant or in other relevant senior administrative support roles, supporting C\-suite or senior leadership (SVP/GVP level or above).
* **Advanced MS Office –** In\-depth understanding of the entire MS Office suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams).
* **AI \& digital productivity skills –** Hands\-on proficiency with AI tools and platforms (e.g., Copilot, ChatGPT, Gemini, AI assistants, automation/agentic tools, transcription and meeting\-intelligence tools); ability to adopt and recommend AI solutions that improve executive productivity.
* **Prioritization –** Ability to organize a daily workload by priorities.
* **Deadline driven –** Must be able to meet deadlines in a fast\-paced, quickly changing environment.
* **Problem solving –** A proactive approach to problem\-solving with strong decision\-making skills.
* **Regional exposure –** Experience coordinating across multiple geographies/time zones (SEA, India, Middle East \& Africa) is preferred.

**What Will Help You Succeed in This Role:**


* Ownership and a “can\-do” attitude with a high bar for quality and follow\-through.
* Judgement, discretion, and the ability to handle sensitive information with absolute trust.
* Anticipation – staying a step ahead of the leaders you support.
* Agility and calm under pressure in a fast\-moving, high\-growth environment.
* A collaborative mindset that builds trust across functions and geographies.
* AI\-forward mindset – curiosity and willingness to continuously learn and apply emerging AI tools in day\-to\-day executive support.

**Location \& Travel:**


This role is based in Hyderabad, India. Managing domestic and international travel arrangements for the SVP – APMEA (including travel to and coordination across SEA, India, Middle East \& Africa) and APMEA leadership team is a core part of the role; occasional travel may be required (assumed).

description:
**Job Description:**


Job Description
**About Us**


At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
  

Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
  

Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in\-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role\-specific responsibilities and business needs.
  

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!


**Global Business Services**


Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations. Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation. In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.


**Process Overview**


The Global Information Security (GIS) is responsible for protecting Bank information systems, confidential and proprietary data, and customer information. The team develops the Bank’s Information Security strategy and policy, manages the Information Security program and identifies and addresses vulnerabilities, Develops, deploys and manages a risk\-based controls portfolio, Manages and operates global security operations center that monitor, detects and responds to cybersecurity incidents.


GIS Identity \& Access management (IAM) Access Control Team goal is to ensure that the control processes and effectiveness are within the identified risk tolerance. Manage the performance and effectiveness of the working control through the establishment of metrics with thresholds. Validate the reasonability of Laws, Rules and Regulations mapping alignment to the controls, as aligned by the GIS Policy team.


**Job Description**


The Data Engineering Services team is seeking a hands\-on IAM Data Scientist to deliver advanced analytics, AI/ML solutions, and data engineering capabilities that strengthen Identity and Access Management controls, governance, and risk reduction across the enterprise.


This role will require to transform complex access, entitlement, identity lifecycle, privileged access, and control data into actionable insights. The candidate will design and develop scalable data pipelines, predictive and detective analytics, AI/ML models, dashboards, and self\-service reporting capabilities that help identify control gaps, access anomalies, toxic combinations, certification inefficiencies, and emerging IAM risks. The role requires strong technical depth in analytics, model development, model governance, AI risk management, and responsible AI practices, with the ability to convert data science outcomes into measurable control improvements and executive\-ready risk narratives.


**Responsibilities**


* Lead advanced analytics and data science initiatives across IAM controls, access governance, entitlement management, privileged access, joiner\-mover\-leaver processes, access certifications, and policy adherence.
* Analyze large, complex, and disparate identity, access, entitlement, control, application, and audit datasets to identify trends, anomalies, control gaps, risk concentrations, and opportunities for automation.
* Design, build, validate, and tune AI/ML models for IAM use cases such as access anomaly detection, entitlement mining, role mining, toxic access identification, certification prioritization, privileged access monitoring, and control effectiveness measurement.
* Develop scalable data pipelines, feature engineering processes, reusable datasets, and analytics frameworks using Python, R, SQL, Splunk, Neo4j, and enterprise\-approved data platforms.
* Design and maintain executive\-ready dashboards, scorecards, and self\-service reporting solutions that convert IAM control data into actionable insights for process owners, risk partners, and senior leadership.
* Embed model governance and AI risk controls into the analytics lifecycle, including documentation, model inventory, validation evidence, explainability, performance monitoring, drift detection, data lineage, reproducibility, and audit traceability.
* Assess and mitigate AI/ML risks including bias, privacy exposure, data quality limitations, explainability gaps, inappropriate automation, overfitting, and adversarial or unintended use of model outputs.
* Partner with IAM, GIS, cyber risk, audit, compliance, privacy, technology, and application teams to translate control requirements into measurable analytics solutions and governance outcomes.
* Drive process improvement and automation by identifying manual control activities, inefficient data handoffs, recurring exceptions, and opportunities to strengthen preventative and detective IAM controls.
* Prepare clear documentation, control evidence, methodology summaries, model performance updates, and risk narratives to support governance reviews, audit readiness, and management reporting.

**Requirements**


**Education :** B.E. / B. Tech/M.E. /M. Tech/B.Sc./M.Sc./BCA/MCA (prefer IT/CS specialization)


**Certifications If Any** : NA

The digitization of tax compliance is fundamentally changing global commerce and how businesses need to operate and grow. * Lead global AR collections strategy to maintain DSO within target thresholds, oversee cash application operations, and establish customer risk segmentation and proactive collection playbooks for high\-value accounts.

* You understand ASC 606 revenue recognition principles and their impact on billing and OTC workflows, ideally gained in a SaaS, technology, or high\-growth software company environment.
* You're proficient with ERP systems (NetSuite, SAP, or Oracle) and CRM/CPQ platforms (Salesforce preferred), OTC analytics (AR ageing, DSO, CEI, cash flow forecasting), and comfortable with AI\-assisted workflows and automation tools.
* CA, CPA, CMA, MBA (Finance), or equivalent experience in finance/accounting
* Due to client contractual obligations, the successful candidate will be asked to clear a background check upon hire.
**THE PROCESS**


We believe in a transparent and comprehensive hiring process. Here's what you might expect:

**2**
**Video Interview**

**4**

**LIFE AT SOVOS**

We do not discriminate against race, colour, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth. Sovos processes nearly 20 billion transactions per year, helping companies scale their compliance strategy in 150\+ countries.

title: Data & Integration Analyst
description:
****Overview****





 We need a data enthusiast who pairs sharp analytical capabilities with the leverage of modern AI tools. As our organization harmonizes multiple disparate systems, data sources, and analytics platforms into a single operational home, this role will lead and orchestrate the collection, cohesion, and maintenance of our core data models (unified accounts, contacts, candidates, deals, activity, and work records).
 





 You will design and oversee the foundational data layer that allows future AI agents to read seamlessly across all entity data without an integration tax, setting the groundwork for our incoming ERP consolidation.
 




  





****What You Own****



* ****Canonical Data Model:****

 Define entity structures, relationships, and identity\-resolution logic across accounts, contacts, candidates, deals, projects, and work records.
* ****Validation at Ingest:****

 Establish upfront validation rules that prevent low\-quality records from entering systems, shifting focus from post\-hoc error reporting to preventative data hygiene.
* ****Integration Layer Coordination:****

 Collaborate with full\-stack engineers to maintain an adaptable integration layer, ensuring vendor replacements require simple configuration rather than a full code rewrite.
* ****Reporting \& Dashboards Foundation:****

 Build and govern the modeled semantic layer beneath our Power BI transition, unifying legacy reports and setting up actionable dashboards for the future ERP.
* ****Agent Data Access:****

 Architect clean, permissioned, and documented read paths so internal AI agents consume structured data directly rather than scraping front\-end source systems.
* ****Data Quality Ownership:****

 Serve as the direct point of contact and owner for recurring systemic data defects.
* ****Migration Strategy:****

 Lead data migration paths off retired legacy systems while preserving historical continuity and audit trails.
* ****Lean AI \& Continuous Improvement:****

 Apply Lean principles and AI tools to reduce data failure points, detect early warning indicators, and define KPIs/SLAs to optimize organizational performance.
* ****Unstructured Data Insights:****

 Monitor, analyze, and process speech, text, and sentiment analysis inputs across business channels.



  





****Requirements****



* ****4\+ years****

 of hands\-on experience in data and analytics, featuring heavy data\-modeling responsibilities.
* Proven track record of designing a canonical data model across multiple source systems, with the ability to articulate trade\-offs in identity resolution and deduplication.
* Deep knowledge of
 
****PostgreSQL****

 (schema design, normalization trade\-offs, database migrations, query performance tuning).
* ****SQL proficiency****

 for data exploration, auditing, reconciliation, and cross\-database validation.
* ****Python expertise****

title: Program and Delivery Manager - AI and Data Delivery
description:
Eaton’s EITC division is currently seeking a Program and Delivery Manager \- AI and Data Delivery.


### **What you’ll do:**



This position leads the delivery of data and artificial intelligence products for the HR, Legal and Corporate Development functions. The role owns the portfolio from demand intake through design, build, deployment and adoption, and is accountable for the scope, schedule, cost and quality of every initiative within it. It is a new role, created to give these functions a dedicated delivery leader as the demand for data and AI capability continues to grow.



The leader manages the HR, Legal and Corporate Development delivery team and acts as the primary point of contact for functional leadership. Working closely with the System Architect, Enterprise Architecture and Cyber Security, the role ensures that solutions handling sensitive employee and legal information meet Eaton architecture, privacy and security standards. The position also serves as secondary owner of the AI Navigator idea\-to\-disposition process for ideas raised by these functions.


* Lead end\-to\-end data and artificial intelligence delivery for the HR, Legal and Corporate Development functions, covering demand intake, prioritization, execution, deployment and value realization.

* Act as secondary owner for AI Navigator idea\-to\-disposition for ideas originating in HR, Legal and Corporate Development, ensuring each idea is assessed, dispositioned and tracked to closure.
* Build and manage the financial plan for the portfolio, including annual budget, project and run forecasting, platform consumption, contractor cost control and variance reporting.
* Partner with the System Architect, Enterprise Architecture and Cyber Security so that solutions comply with architecture guardrails, data privacy obligations and information security standards applicable to employee and legal data.
* Establish and operate delivery governance, covering status reporting, risk and issue management, dependency management, change control and steering reviews.
* Drive adoption of Agile delivery practices and improve predictability, cycle time and quality through objective delivery metrics.
* Manage supplier and partner relationships, including statements of work, resource onboarding and performance against agreed service levels.
* Champion organizational change management and user adoption for AI products, and ensure realised benefits are measured and communicated to stakeholders.

### **Qualifications**


* Bachelor degree in a technical discipline such as B.E. / B.Tech / MCA, or B.S. in Computer Science, Mathematics or Engineering. A master degree or MBA is preferred.
* 14 or more years of relevant industry experience in information technology delivery.
* 8 or more years leading program or project delivery for data, analytics or application products in a global organization.
* 4 or more years of direct people leadership of engineering teams that include employees and contract resources.

### **Skills**


* Project or program management certification such as PMP, PgMP, Scrum Master or SAFe is preferred.
* Experience delivering technology for HR, Legal or Corporate Development functions, including work with confidential employee or legal data, is preferred.
* Working knowledge of data engineering and analytics platforms, including data pipelines, data warehousing and reporting on Microsoft Azure.
* Practical understanding of artificial intelligence and generative AI solution patterns, including large language models, retrieval augmented generation, prompt design and accuracy evaluation.
* Strong command of program and portfolio management disciplines covering scope, schedule, cost, risk, quality and benefits management.
* Experience running Agile delivery at scale using Scrum, Kanban or SAFe, with hands\-on use of Azure DevOps or equivalent tooling.
* Understanding of enterprise application integration, application programming interfaces and workflow automation.
* Familiarity with data privacy, records retention and information security requirements that apply to employee, legal and corporate development data.
* Financial management capability covering budgeting, forecasting, vendor contracting and cost control.
* Executive communication and stakeholder management, with the ability to translate technical work into business outcomes.
* Ability to lead through influence across a matrixed, global organization and across time zones.
* Proven capability in coaching, developing talent and building inclusive, high\-performing teams.
* Structured problem solving and sound decision making in conditions of ambiguity.
* Customer focus, solution orientation and a strong drive for results.


All positions may require participation in video and in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process. All candidates will be evaluated based on job\-related competencies, and all candidates’ privacy rights and data security will be protected in accordance with applicable laws.

Our recruitment processes use balanced selection criteria and avoid unlawful discrimination against applicants on the basis of their age, colour, disability, marital status, national origin, gender, gender identity, genetic information, race or racial origin, religion, sexual orientation or any other status protected or required by law.

title: Prompt Engineer
description:
You'll be the person who makes our AI agents sound right — and convert. At JoyzAI, that means owning the prompts and conversation design behind every client's AI calling agent and chatbot: how the agent opens a call, how it qualifies a lead, how it handles "I'm busy, call me later," how it declines a question it shouldn't answer, and how it does all of that in the client's voice, in English or Hinglish.
 



 This is not a prompt\-tweaking role. It's a design\-and\-own role. You write the prompt, you listen to the calls it produced, you find where it broke, and you fix it — for real clients, in production, with real leads on the other end of the line.
 



  





**What you'll do** 




  





**Prompt \& conversation design** 



* Translate each client's business requirements into prompt strategies, conversation flows, and guardrails for their AI calling agent and chatbot.
* Design voice\-first conversations — greetings, one\-question\-per\-turn flows, objection handling, voicemail/no\-answer/silence fallbacks, and handoffs to WhatsApp for links and addresses.
* Build and maintain the prompts behind core workflows: lead qualification, FAQs, appointment booking, and follow\-up sequences.
* Nail tone and persona for each client, including Hinglish where their customers speak it.



  





**Testing \& optimisation** 



* Read call transcripts and chat logs every day. Catch the weak answers, the hallucinations, the places the agent talks too much or asks two questions at once.
* Run structured experiments — A/B prompt variants, regression test sets, edge\-case scripts — and measure what actually moved: qualification rate, drop\-offs, escalations, wrong answers.
* Ship prompt improvements fast and safely, without breaking what was already working.
* Document prompt frameworks and reusable templates so the next client's agent starts from a better baseline than the last.



  





**Clients \& the team** 



* Sit in on kickoffs and go\-lives with customer success to understand how the client's sales process actually works before you write a word.
* Work with engineering on what the platform needs — new behaviours, better tooling for testing prompts, model changes.
* Feed what you learn from the logs back to product and sales so the whole company gets smarter about what works on a call.



  





  





 Roughly 70% of your time is hands\-on: writing and testing prompts, reading transcripts, running experiments. The other 30% is with clients and the team — understanding the business behind the agent and figuring out what a better conversation is worth to them. Expect that balance to shift toward the thinking as our testing tooling matures.
 



  





 We're under 15 people building AI calling agents. This is not a comfortable corporate job. You'll be in the trenches, you'll work hard, and you'll compress ten years of ordinary career growth into two (this means salary growth also, not just more work).
 



  





**What we're looking for** 




 Two things are non\-negotiable. Please apply only if you meet both — they're the first thing we screen for.
 


* **You've worked at a Voice AI company.** 
 Professionally, on AI voice agents or conversational voice products. You know what makes a voice conversation actually work: turn\-taking, interruptions, latency, STT/TTS quirks, keeping the agent on track without it sounding robotic.
* **You've built AI agents for clients, not for yourself.** 
 You've taken a client's requirements, shipped an agent their real customers talked to, and iterated on it using live conversation data. Personal projects, hackathon demos, and coursework don't count.



  





 Beyond that, we don't care much about degrees or years. We care that you can:
 


* Design prompts and script conversations that hold up under systematic testing, not just in the happy path.
* Work comfortably with LLMs and conversational AI platforms, with a basic grasp of NLP concepts.
* Read analytics and transcripts and turn them into concrete prompt changes with measurable results.
* Write clearly and concisely for business and customer\-facing communication, with a good ear for tone and context.
* Gather requirements from PMs, engineers, sales, and clients, and iterate quickly without waiting to be told.
* Think in a structured way, sweat the details, and document what you did so others can build on it.



  





 Nice to have: experience with sales tech, CRM systems, or customer support automation.
 



  





 Full\-time, on\-site in Noida.
 



  





**Why JoyzAI?** 




 ✨ Utmost freedom and autonomy — to make decisions. You are the taskmaster, do it the way you think is best. We will only suggest.
 



 ✨ Complete responsibility. You are the taskmaster. Take responsibility for it.
 



 ✨ Top\-of\-the\-market pay – we reward high performance with the best packages.
 



 ✨ 5\-day working – weekends are yours to recharge.
 



 ✨ Work from office in Noida – collaborate, learn, and grow with a passionate team.
 



 ✨ High\-growth startup – opportunity to see first hand how AI brings change and be a part of that.

The role serves as the primary conduit between Business and IT — collaborating with the Data Infrastructure and AI Infrastructure teams to convert prioritized business opportunities into deployed, value\-generating AI solutions. **Role Accountability**
**Enterprise AI Strategy \& Prioritization**
* Own the enterprise AI roadmap, aligning AI investments to strategic priorities and quantified business value.
* Build and maintain a prioritized pipeline of AI/GenAI use cases across acquisition, engagement, risk, collections, service, and cost efficiency.
* Partner with the Transformation team to sequence interventions by impact, feasibility, and readiness, ensuring scarce capacity is directed to the highest\-value opportunities.
* Work jointly with the Data Infrastructure and AI Infrastructure teams to shape data pipelines, model platforms, and deployment architecture required for each use case.
* Ensure business intent is carried through design, build, and deployment, resolving trade\-offs between ambition, feasibility, and time\-to\-value.


**Delivery Governance – On Time \& In Full**
* Drive timely and in\-full (OTIF) implementation of prioritized AI initiatives through disciplined planning, milestone tracking, and issue resolution.
* Establish delivery cadence, dependency management, and escalation mechanisms in partnership with the Transformation PMO.
* Manage cross\-functional risks, remove blockers, and hold owners accountable for committed timelines and outcomes.


**Data \& AI Infrastructure Partnership**
* Collaborate with the Data Infrastructure team to ensure availability, quality, lineage, and governance of the data assets that power AI models.
* Work with the AI Infrastructure team on model platforms, ML Ops, deployment pipelines, monitoring, and scalability of production AI.
* Ensure AI solutions are engineered for reliability, reusability, and enterprise scale rather than one\-off pilots.


**Value Realization \& Performance Tracking**
* Define baselines, benefit estimates, KPI targets, and measurement methodologies for every AI intervention.
* Track realized impact on customer acquisition, CLTV, risk reduction, cost efficiency, and productivity, linking each initiative to quantified value.
* Provide data\-driven narratives on progress, gaps, and interventions for leadership reviews and strategic forums.


**Governance, Risk \& Responsible AI**
* Institutionalize model governance, documentation, versioning, and monitoring in line with regulatory expectations (RBI, DPDPA etc).
* Embed responsible\-AI principles — fairness, explainability, data privacy, and security — across the AI lifecycle.
* Partner with Risk, Compliance, and Information Security to ensure AI deployments meet legal, regulatory, and contractual requirements.


**Measures of Success**
 Number and business impact of AI use cases prioritized, deployed, and scaled across the enterprise.
   

  

* On\-time \& in\-full (OTIF) delivery of committed AI interventions.
* Measurable impact on acquisition, CLTV, risk reduction, cost efficiency, and productivity driven by AI.
* Strength of the Business–IT partnership, and maturity of data and AI infrastructure enabling scale.
* Continuity of implementation with minimal downtime and risk discovery; robustness of AI governance, model reliability, and responsible\-AI compliance.
* Technical Skills / Experience / Certifications
* Strong understanding of AI/ML and GenAI concepts, use\-case design, and end\-to\-end AI solution delivery.
* Working knowledge of data engineering, ML Ops, model deployment, and cloud/AI infrastructure fundamentals.
* Strong program delivery, dependency management, and stakeholder governance experience.


**Competencies critical to the role**

* Program governance

* Model governance
* Regulatory expectations (RBI, DPDPA), and Enterprise data governance


**Qualification**
 Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or related technical discipline.
   

  

 Master’s degree (MBA/Analytics/AI/ML/Data Science) preferred.
   

  

 Certifications in AI/ML, GenAI, Data Engineering, Cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), or ML Ops are an added advantage.

 BFSI, Fintech etc

title: Consultant — Enterprise Change & Transformation
description:
AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.

At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived.

***We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD.***  

The Enterprise Change \& Transformation Consultant builds organizations' capacity to change continuously — not just to land a single initiative. Rather than executing one\-off communication and training plans for a discrete rollout, this role helps clients stand up durable change capability: Centers of Excellence, self\-service playbooks, and manager\-led change practices that make the organization resilient to constant transformation, well beyond any one project's go\-live date.



Consistent with AHEAD's Consultant capability tier, this role is the engine of an engagement: day\-to\-day contact for analyst\- and manager\-level client stakeholders, and owner of a discrete enterprise change and transformation deliverable or workstream. The Consultant structures sub\-problems, develops hypotheses, and produces client\-ready work with limited supervision, while beginning to informally coach Associates.



### **What's New in This Role**



From Project\-Based to Capability Building



This role moves beyond writing communication plans and hosting training sessions for a single software rollout or restructure. The focus shifts to establishing internal Centers of Excellence, coaching line managers to lead their own teams through constant shifts, and creating scalable self\-service playbooks so the entire organization becomes resilient to ongoing transformation — not just the current project.



From Activity Metrics to Value Realization



Success is no longer measured by output metrics such as emails sent, town halls hosted, or training modules completed. The Consultant uses data and analytics to prove actual behavioral change, tracks real business outcomes, and measures value realization long after a project's go\-live date.



Integration of Artificial Intelligence



Rather than relying entirely on manual stakeholder mapping, generic templates, and human\-crafted messaging, the Consultant utilizes enterprise AI tools to draft communications, analyze employee feedback sentiment, map impact data rapidly, and scale day\-to\-day practitioner workflows.


### **Responsibilities**



Enterprise Change Capability \& Transformation


* Support the design and stand\-up of client Centers of Excellence (CoE) for change, including governance, playbooks, and role definitions that let the client sustain change practice after AHEAD's engagement ends.


* Coach line managers to lead their own teams through continuous, overlapping shifts, building manager\-led change capability rather than centralizing it with the project team.


* Develop scalable, self\-service change playbooks, toolkits, and templates that business units can apply independently to future transformations.


* Apply OCM theories and models, such as Prosci and ADKAR, to develop and conduct OCM assessments and plans, adapted for an enterprise, continuous\-change context rather than a single rollout.


* Analyze change impacts across processes, systems, culture, and people; identify affected stakeholders and understand their needs, concerns, and influence across multiple concurrent initiatives.


* Support the development of digital transformation roadmaps and lead defined workstreams that translate business needs into actionable change, adoption, and implementation plans.


* Provide change management guidance to project teams and business partners, with an emphasis on building their independent change capability.



Value Realization \& Outcome Measurement


* Design and track outcome\-based metrics — behavioral adoption, productivity, and business KPIs — rather than activity metrics such as communications sent or sessions hosted.


* Use data and analytics to demonstrate actual behavioral change resulting from transformation initiatives, and to identify where adoption is stalling.


* Establish stakeholder feedback mechanisms, analyze feedback, and recommend adjustments to the change management strategy based on evidence, not activity completion.


* Support the identification and tracking of KPIs, surveys, and reports that measure business value realization well beyond a project's go\-live date.


* Build basic financial and business\-case components (cost/benefit, ROI/TCO inputs) that tie change outcomes to the commercial story.



AI\-Enabled Change Practice


* Utilize enterprise AI tools to draft stakeholder communications, accelerating and improving the quality of first\-draft messaging.


* Apply AI\-based sentiment analysis to employee feedback to surface adoption risk and stakeholder concerns faster than manual review allows.


* Use AI\-assisted tools to rapidly map change impact and stakeholder data across large or overlapping initiatives.


* Identify opportunities to scale day\-to\-day practitioner workflows (stakeholder mapping, reporting, content drafting) using enterprise AI tools, in place of fully manual methods.



Engagement \& Practice Contribution


* Manage assigned deliverables and support enterprise change and digital transformation initiatives as part of larger project engagements, exercising judgment with appropriate oversight.


* Manage communication across multiple stakeholder groups, including senior leadership, and facilitate team meetings and presentations.


* Structure sub\-problems within a workstream into a clear analytical workplan, identifying the right analyses, inputs, and sequence of work, and explain to a Manager why the approach answers the client's question.


* Develop preliminary hypotheses with guidance from a Senior Consultant or Manager, design analyses that test them, and update the hypothesis when the data disagrees.


* Develop a working understanding of project economics on assigned engagements — billing rates, team composition, utilization targets, and margin structure.


* Informally coach Associates on the engagement, improving how they structure work, review output, and explain their thinking.


* Support at least one practice\-building initiative by producing reusable content (playbooks, frameworks, case studies) adopted by other teams.


* Own research and analysis for at least one thought\-leadership workstream, contributing analytical content to a published point of view or white paper.


* Identify follow\-on opportunities on current engagements and surface client needs to engagement leadership; contribute to 1–2 proposals or pursuits per year, owning sections of the response with guidance.


### **Core Skills \& Capabilities**


* Strong understanding of change management fundamentals and enterprise change capability\-building, backed by at least 3 years of hands\-on OCM or transformation experience.


* Ability to design and stand up scalable change capability (Centers of Excellence, self\-service playbooks, manager\-led practices) rather than only executing a project\-specific plan.


* Ability to define and track outcome\- and value\-based metrics, distinct from activity metrics, and to connect change adoption to business results.


* Working proficiency with enterprise AI tools for communications drafting, sentiment analysis, and impact/stakeholder mapping, applied with sound judgment.


* Proficiency in the Prosci ADKAR methodology, with the ability to apply Prosci tools and frameworks to assess change readiness, build change plans, and drive adoption.


* Strong project management, critical thinking, problem\-solving, data analysis, and information\-structuring skills.


* Ability to support digital transformation roadmapping and lead defined initiative workstreams in partnership with client stakeholders and project teams.


* Working knowledge of project economics — billing rates, utilization, and margin — sufficient to support scope and staffing conversations with engagement leadership.


### **Core Consulting Skills**


* Client relationship management, including building trust, managing expectations, and serving as a credible advisor to business and IT stakeholders at the analyst and manager level.


* Business acumen, with the ability to understand client industries, operating models, and strategic priorities to frame recommendations in business terms.


* Executive presence and polished presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly to senior leadership and diverse audiences.


* Analytical and structured problem\-solving skills, with the ability to break down ambiguous business problems into clear, actionable workstreams and defensible hypotheses.


* Effective time management and prioritization across multiple workstreams, deliverables, and competing deadlines in a fast\-paced consulting environment.


* Collaborative teaming skills, working effectively within cross\-functional project teams and adapting style to diverse team and client cultures.


* Informal coaching and feedback skills — makes junior team members better through the way work is structured, reviewed, and explained, without formal management authority.


* Proficiency with core consulting toolkits (e.g., PowerPoint, Excel, Word) and enterprise AI tools to produce polished deliverables, executive\-ready presentations, and data\-driven analyses.


* Adaptability and sound judgment when navigating ambiguity, shifting priorities, and evolving client needs across engagements.


### **Required Qualifications**


* Minimum 3 years of recent, relevant Organizational Change Management (OCM) or enterprise transformation experience, including supporting, driving, and facilitating change as part of a project or transformation; 5\-8 years of overall professional experience consistent with AHEAD's Consultant capability tier.


* Demonstrated success delivering client services in a collaborative, dynamic, and fast\-paced environment.


* Previous experience supporting organizational change efforts of varying scale and complexity; experience building change capability (CoEs, playbooks, manager coaching) is a plus.


* Experience using data and analytics to measure adoption or business outcomes, beyond activity\-based reporting, is a plus.


* Familiarity or hands\-on experience with enterprise AI tools applied to communications, sentiment analysis, or stakeholder/impact mapping is a plus.


* Demonstrated ability to own a discrete deliverable or workstream with limited supervision, and to informally coach or support junior team members.


* Prosci certification required.


* Willing and able to travel to client sites as needed for project delivery, approximately 25%.


### **Growth Path**



This role sits at the Consultant tier of AHEAD's Career GPS capability ladder. Growth into Senior Consultant is marked by leading multiple workstreams in parallel, shaping approach and workplans rather than executing tasks handed down, actively coaching juniors, owning client sub\-relationships, and



proactively identifying and escalating delivery risks — increasingly applied to enterprise\-scale change capability rather than single\-project change management


**Why AHEAD:**

Through our daily work and internal groups like Moving Women AHEAD and RISE AHEAD, we value and benefit from diversity of people, ideas, experience, and everything in between.

We fuel growth by stacking our office with top\-notch technologies in a multi\-million\-dollar lab, by encouraging cross department training and development, sponsoring certifications and credentials for continued learning.

**Comprehensive health insurance** coverage for employees, with options to extend coverage to dependents
**Paid time off and company holidays**, along with additional leave benefits as per policy
**Flexible work arrangements**, supporting work\-life balance
**Learning and development opportunities** to support continuous growth and upskilling
**Employee wellness initiatives** and programs focused on physical and mental well\-being
**Retirement and statutory benefits** in line with India regulations
**Inclusive and people\-first culture**, with a strong focus on collaboration and ownership

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: On-site Support Lead APAC
description:
Our search for better is changing the lives of our patients. It’s changing the careers of our people too – creating new challenges and opportunities all the time. We're looking for a motivated and passionate individual to join our team as an On\-Site Support Lead APAC, to have real impact and bring Forever Caring to life.  

In this role, you'll play a key part in on\-site support, working alongside a dynamic team that values innovation, collaboration, and continuous growth.


Your key responsibilities will include:

**Regional On\-Site Support delivery**

* Lead and manage the regional field\-support onsite technician team, ensuring compliance with SLAs/OLAs and KPIs.
* Own hardware lifecycle management, user lifecycle management and incident escalation management across the region.
* Provide in\-depth performance metrics against regional SLAs, deliver proactive guidance and assess the effectiveness of field service teams.
* Contribute to support operation manuals, documentation and the expansion of the internal knowledge base.
* Evaluate risks associated with proposed change requests, present alternative solutions, and participate in Change Advisory Boards.
* Drive proactive service\-improvement initiatives and cost\-benefit analyses aligned with IT Global guidelines.

**Project coordination \& follow\-up (small\-scale initiatives across On\-Site Support globally)**

* Coordinate and follow up on small IT projects across On\-Site Support globally, providing the organisation, tracking and focus needed to bring them to completion on time.
* Maintain clear visibility of scope, milestones, actions and risks, keeping stakeholders informed and initiatives on track.
* Apply, where relevant, Convatec's StageGate project methodology and PPM tooling to structure delivery and reporting.

**Global bridge with the PMOs (primary point of liaison for OSS)**

* Act as the primary global point of contact between On\-Site Support and both the Digital \& AI PMO and the CBS PMO — treated as equivalent interlocutors — facilitating and coordinating the relationship together with the regional On\-Site Support leads, who remain accountable for delivery in their own regions.
* Ensure that, for any global project requiring OSS participation anywhere in the world, OSS is identified, engaged and mobilised on time.
* Translate PMO requirements into clear OSS actions, working with and through the regional On\-Site Support leads, and channel OSS readiness, constraints and dependencies back to the PMOs.
* Support gate submissions and project governance by providing timely OSS input, effort estimates and delivery status.

**Stakeholder \& team management**

* Strengthen relationships with stakeholders and business units, acting as the voice of the customer between technical teams and users.
* Recruit, develop and retain field service teams, and conduct cost/benefit analyses for the regional teams.
* Stay in contact with senior end\-users and understand the region from a cultural perspective to provide better support.
* Ensure consistent achievement of agreed Service Level Targets, with ongoing reporting through service\-level reports and monthly service review meetings.


To be successful you will:

**Function / technical experience**

* Minimum 5\+ years in a leadership role in IT.
* Strong knowledge of IT infrastructure, networks, servers, cloud computing and security.
* Proficiency in ITIL or similar IT service\-management frameworks.
* Familiarity with monitoring, automation and incident\-management tools and technologies.
* Solid understanding of regulatory and compliance requirements in the regions of operation.
* Project coordination skills with the ability to organise, track and drive small initiatives to completion across cross\-functional teams; knowledge / experience of the StageGate project methodology would add significant value (not mandatory).
* Proficiency in MS Office and ServiceNow.

**Soft skills \& competencies**

* Exceptional problem\-solving, decision\-making and communication skills.
* Strong organisation, follow\-up discipline and a results/focus orientation.
* Ability to coordinate across regions, cultures and time zones, and to build strong stakeholder relationships.
* Proactivity in improving processes and motivating teams; adaptability in a fast\-paced environment.

title: System Administrator - IT
description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE**

We're a growing MSME looking for a hands\-on System Administrator to own our IT infrastructure end\-to\-end — from servers and networks to day\-to\-day employee tech support. This person will be our first responder on infra issues and independently own daily operations, escalating to leadership or vendors only when something is genuinely host\-level or production\-critical. Ideal for someone who likes wearing multiple hats and can work independently without narrow specialization.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Infrastructure \& Servers
* Install, configure, and maintain servers (Windows/Linux), workstations, and networking equipment
* Manage on\-prem infrastructure and virtualization (Proxmox/VMware/Hyper\-V)
* Monitor performance, disk space, memory, and uptime; proactively fix bottlenecks
* Set up and maintain backups and disaster recovery
* Understand VM resource allocation (RAM ballooning, CPU steal time, dedicated vs. shared host resources) and diagnose host\-level performance issues that surface inside the guest OS

**Network \& Security**

* Configure routers, switches, firewalls, and Wi\-Fi access points
* Manage VPN access, firewall rules, and endpoint/antivirus protection
* Handle user access, permissions, and Active Directory accounts
* Ensure basic cybersecurity hygiene — patching, updates, vulnerability checks

**IT Support \& Operations**

* Provide first\- and second\-line support (hardware, software, email, printers, connectivity)
* Manage IT procurement, inventory, and vendor relationships (ISPs, AMC vendors, suppliers)
* Maintain IT asset documentation and SOPs
* Handle employee onboarding/offboarding for systems and access
* Act as first responder on infra incidents; escalate to leadership or hosting/infra vendors when an issue is host\-level or production\-critical

**REQUIRED SKILLS**

* Bachelor's degree/diploma in IT/CS or equivalent practical experience
* 2–5 years in system administration, IT support, or network management
* Working knowledge of Windows Server/Linux environments
* Hands\-on experience with physical servers — installation, racking, RAID, hardware upgrades (RAM/storage/NIC) on Dell PowerEdge, HP ProLiant, or similar
* Solid networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, firewalls)
* Experience with backups, antivirus/endpoint tools, and basic cybersecurity practices
* Independent troubleshooting across hardware, software, and connectivity
* Comfortable with process managers for Node.js apps (PM2 or similar) — monitoring, log triage, restart\-loop diagnosis, zombie/defunct process cleanup
* Basic familiarity with database health monitoring (connection pools, slow queries, checkpointer/WAL behavior for Postgres or equivalent for MongoDB)
* Basic scripting (Bash/PowerShell) is a plus
* Good communication skills for explaining technical issues to non\-technical staff

**GOOD TO HAVE**

* Cloud exposure (AWS, Azure, GCP, or Indian providers like E2E Networks)
* Exposure to Nginx as a reverse proxy — timeout tuning, large file uploads, SSL config
* Certifications like CompTIA A\+/Network\+, MCSA, or CCNA (not mandatory)

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* End\-to\-end ownership of IT operations with real decision\-making authority
* Direct exposure to leadership and cross\-functional teams
* Competitive salary based on experience

Work Location: In person

**About HavStrategy**

HavStrategy is a data\-driven digital marketing and performance growth agency that helps D2C, eCommerce, fashion, beauty, lifestyle, luxury, and consumer brands achieve sustainable business growth through innovative marketing strategies, performance marketing, branding, data analytics, and business consulting.

As a Founder's Office Executive, you will work directly with the founders and leadership team, driving strategic initiatives, business operations, and cross\-functional execution with a high degree of ownership. This role is ideal for a self\-driven professional who can independently manage projects, translate strategy into execution, and act as a trusted extension of the founders.

**Key Responsibilities**

***Strategic \& Business Support***

* Partner with the founders on strategic business initiatives, high\-priority projects, and organizational goal\-setting.
* Own end\-to\-end business planning, execution tracking, and performance monitoring against goals.
* Lead market research, industry analysis, competitor benchmarking, and trend analysis to inform decisions.
* Identify and evaluate growth opportunities through market insights and business data.
* Independently prepare business proposals, strategy documents, and board/leadership\-ready reports.

***Project Management \& Operations***

* Drive coordination across departments to ensure timely, high\-quality completion of projects.
* Own project timelines, deliverables, and key milestones, escalating risks proactively.

 The MEPF Lead plays a critical role in JLL's Projects Development Services, providing technical leadership and oversight for building systems across the project lifecycle. This position ensures that MEP/FP installations meet client requirements, comply with codes and standards, and are delivered on time and within budget.

Review and approve design drawings, specifications, and calculations to ensure compliance with building codes, industry standards, and client requirements. Coordinate with architects, structural engineers, and other design consultants to integrate MEPF systems effectively into overall building design. Coordinate with contractors, subcontractors, and vendors to ensure proper installation and system integration. Conduct regular site visits to monitor construction progress, verify quality, and resolve technical issues. Quality Assurance Compliance: Ensure all MEPF installations comply with local, state, and federal regulations including building codes, energy codes, and safety standards. Review submittals, shop drawings, and product data for conformance with design intent and specifications. Oversee testing, balancing, and commissioning activities to verify system performance. Client Stakeholder Management: Serve as the primary technical point of contact for clients on MEPF matters. Present design options, value engineering alternatives, and technical recommendations to clients and stakeholders. Prepare technical reports, progress updates, and presentations for client meetings. Risk Management Problem Solving: Identify potential technical risks and develop mitigation strategies throughout the project lifecycle. Resolve design conflicts, construction issues, and system performance problems efficiently. Manage change orders and assess their impact on project scope, schedule, and budget. Team Development Collaboration: Mentor junior engineers and technical staff on MEPF best practices and standards. Collaborate with JLL's multidisciplinary project teams including project managers, cost consultants, and sustainability advisors. Support business development efforts through technical proposal preparation and client presentations. 
 
 Required Qualifications

Minimum 8-10 years of experience in MEPF design, construction, or project management within commercial real estate, preferably in consulting or owners representation roles. Proficiency in reading and interpreting construction drawings, specifications, and technical documents.  Project Business Skills

Excellent communication and presentation skills for technical and non-technical audiences. Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.

 Preferred Qualifications

Experience with data centers, healthcare facilities, laboratory environments, or other mission-critical facilities. Knowledge of smart building technologies, IoT integration, and building analytics platforms. Experience working on corporate workplace, life sciences, or industrial projects. 
 
 Working Conditions

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
**Overview of the role** 




  





 At
 **FRND** 
 , you’ll build, ship, and own the ML systems that help keep
 **millions of real\-time interactions safe,** 
 while also pushing the boundaries with new AI experiments.
 



  





 FRND is built around live social interaction. People connect through
 **1:1 video calls, audio rooms, many\-to\-many conversations, and messaging** 
 across dozens of languages, all in real time. 🌐
 



  





 As a
 **Machine Learning Engineer,** 
 you’ll work on problems that are both
 **high\-scale and high\-impact,** 
 taking ML problems from dataset design all the way to production inference. You’ll work closely with
 **Backend, Product, and Moderatio teams** 
 to turn complex safety challenges into models that actually work in the real world.
 



  





**🧠 What You’ll Do** 




  




* 🎯 Design, train, and deploy production ML models across
 **image/video, audio, and text** 
 .
* 🔄 Own the
 **complete model lifecycle,** 
 from dataset design and labelling guidelines to training, fine\-tuning, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and retraining.
* ⚡ Build and scale
 **low\-latency inference services** 
 for real\-time moderation using Python, PyTorch, Docker, Kubernetes, and streaming infrastructure such as Kafka.
* 📊 Define the metrics that actually matter for safety, including precision at a fixed recall, performance across languages and geographies, and the real cost of false positives on genuine users.
* 🤖 Use
 **LLMs and foundation models** 
 pragmatically for labelling, policy classifiers, and evaluation, while balancing cost, accuracy, and latency.
* 🔍 Partner with Moderation and Policy teams to analyse misclassifications, close the data loop, and translate evolving safety policies into model behaviour.
* 🚀 Continuously improve
 **model performance, throughput, and serving costs** 
 through techniques such as distillation, optimization, and refactoring.
* 🛠️ Set engineering standards across the ML stack, reproducible training, experiment tracking, versioned datasets and models, and reliable production workflows.
* 👥 Mentor junior engineers and interns and help raise the overall engineering bar for the team.
* 🔬 Stay on top of the latest research and tooling across
 **Computer Vision, Audio, NLP, and Trust \& Safety** 
 and turn the useful stuff into real\-world improvements.



  





 💪
 **What We’re Looking For** 




  




* **4–6 years of experience as a Machine Learning Engineer, Applied Scientist, or similar role, with a strong track record of shipping ML models to production, not just research or notebooks.**
* 🐍 Strong proficiency in
 **Python** 
 with deep hands\-on experience in
 **PyTorch or TensorFlow** 
 .
* 🎥 Strong depth in at least one of
 **Computer Vision, Audio/Speech ML, or NLP** 
 , along with working familiarity across the others. This role touches all three.
* 🧩 Experience with
 **transformer architectures and modern pretrained backbones** 
 , including ViTs, wav2vec/Whisper\-style audio models, and BERT/LLM\-family text models, along with experience fine\-tuning them on domain\-specific data.
* ⚙️ Proven experience taking models into production — including serving, latency and throughput optimization, batching, GPU utilization, and monitoring live systems.
* 🏗️ Strong software engineering fundamentals including software design, testing, code reviews, and Git, along with practical experience using
 **Docker and Kubernetes** 
 .
* 🗄️ Experience working with data at scale, including
 **SQL, PostgreSQL, non\-relational databases, analytical databases such as ClickHouse, and streaming systems such as Kafka** 
 .
* 📈 Strong understanding of
 **ML evaluation and experimentation** 
 — metric selection, class imbalance, drift detection, A/B testing, and human\-in\-the\-loop labelling pipelines.
* ⭐
 **Good to have:** 
 Experience in Trust \& Safety, content moderation, fraud/abuse detection, or Responsible AI.
* 🌍
 **Good to have:** 
 Experience working with
 **multilingual and code\-mixed data** 
 .
* ☁️
 **Good to have:** 
 Experience with cloud ML infrastructure on
 **AWS or GCP** 
 .
* 🧠 Excellent problem\-solving skills and the ability to thrive in a
 **fast\-paced, high\-ownership environment** 
 .
* 🤝 Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams.



  





 ⚠️ A Quick Note on the Work
 



  





 As part of building and improving our Trust \& Safety systems, you may occasionally work with
 **user\-reported content that can include sensitive material** 
 . We’re upfront about this during the interview process, and you’ll have the
 **support and resources you need from the team** 
 .
 



  





 📅 Note \- The
 **1st and 3rd Saturdays** 
 of every month are working days.
 



  





**About FRND** 




  





 FRND is redefining the way people connect by building social products that are engaging, safe, inclusive, and fun.
 



  





 We’re a rapidly growing startup building for millions of users and solving unique challenges across social connection and entertainment. Our ambition is bold, and we're looking for people who want to build, experiment, and solve problems at scale.
 



  





**Why FRND?** 




  





 🌍
 **Impact at Scale:** 
 Work on products and initiatives that impact millions of users across India and international markets.
 



 🚀
 **High Ownership:** 
 Take on meaningful problems and have the freedom to drive them from idea to execution.
 



 🧠
 **Learn with the Best:** 
 Work closely with founders, leaders, and high\-performing teams while solving real business challenges.
 



 💼
 **Rewarding Journey:** 
 Competitive compensation, equity opportunities, and growth that matches your impact.
 



 🎉
 **Work Hard, Have Fun:** 
 We're serious about building great products, but we also believe in enjoying the journey along the way.
 



 💡
 **Solve Interesting Problems:** 
 Work in an environment where curiosity, experimentation, and first\-principles thinking are encouraged.

* Demonstrated creative and proactive mindset with a drive for continuous improvement

title: AI product Engineer
description:
**About Opptra:** 




 Opptra (www.opptra.com) is revolutionizing global expansion for consumer brands with a focus on ecommerce and digital capabilities. We're building a portfolio of category\-specialized franchising businesses, powered by our centralized technology platform and global supply chain infrastructure.
 



 We create market access through franchising businesses that serve as master franchisees or licensing partners for brands entering new markets. Unlike traditional distribution partners that prioritize brick\-and\-mortar channels, our businesses leverage advanced ecommerce expertise to accelerate market entry while balancing online and offline channels to match local consumer behavior.
 



 With 70% of global consumer growth driven by Asia, we're currently focused on enabling access to these high\-potential markets. Our model offers brands significant advantages:
 



 \* Reduced market entry costs
 



 \* Broader consumer reach
 



 \* Faster testing and learning capabilities than traditional retail
 



 \* Local expertise with global backing
 



  





**THE ROLE** 




 Opptra is an
 **AI\-first company** 
 helping international brands expand into Asia — across India, GCC, and SEA — through franchising, licensing, and inventory\-led partnerships. We move fast, build with intent, and run lean.
 



 We’re not hiring a PM and an engineer separately. We’re looking for
 **one person who can do both** 
 — talk to a warehouse ops lead, understand the problem they’re describing, sketch a solution, and ship it within the same sprint. You will gather requirements, design flows, write code, deploy, and iterate in direct partnership with business and functional teams.
 



 .
 



**WHAT YOU’LL DO** 



* Sit with business and ops teams, run discovery conversations, and translate fuzzy pain points into clear product specs — without a PM in between.
* Design lightweight AI\-native solutions: agents, RAG pipelines, automation workflows, or internal tools — whichever solves the problem best.
* Build full\-stack: React/Next.js frontends, Python or Node backends, BigQuery\-connected APIs, and LLM integrations using OpenAI, Anthropic, or open\-source models.
* Deploy and maintain your own work — CI/CD, monitoring, iteration — not hand it off to someone else to ship.
* Iterate in the open: share weekly updates with stakeholders, incorporate feedback quickly, and kill features that don’t work without ego.
* Participate in the AI roadmap — you’ll have a real say in what gets built next, and why.



  





**THE SIX PILLARS OF THIS ROLE** 



* **GATHER:** 
 Discovery, stakeholder interviews, translating ops problems into product requirements.
* **BUILD:** 
 Full\-stack engineering with AI components — not just the API call, but the whole product.
* **SHIP:** 
 Deploy to production, instrument for observability, make it usable for non\-technical users.
* **ITERATE:** 
 Fast feedback loops with real users; improve ruthlessly based on evidence, not opinion.
* **PARTNER:** 
 Embedded with business functions — not siloed in a separate tech team.
* **OWN:** 
 Full accountability from problem definition to outcome, including what your AI systems do overnight.



  





**TECHNICAL DEPTH WE EXPECT** 



* **AI / LLM.** 
 You build with LLMs — not just use them. You understand prompt design, model selection tradeoffs, RAG architecture, agent orchestration, and how to evaluate AI output quality.
* **Frontend.** 
 React or Next.js, component design, data\-dense UIs (dashboards, tables, filters) — you build interfaces that non\-technical users actually want to use.
* **Backend.** 
 REST APIs (Python / Node), database design, BigQuery or similar, event\-driven patterns, and integrations with third\-party APIs (marketplace, logistics, catalog feeds).
* **Deployment.** 
 Docker, basic CI/CD, cloud hosting — you can get your own code to prod without infra support.
* **Data literacy.** 
 You can query, understand, and act on data — SQL fluency and a working instinct for metrics.



  





**FOUNDER DNA — WHAT OPPTRA REWARDS** 



* **Ships, doesn’t just specify:** 
 Evidence of real products in production matters more than design docs or decks.
* **Owns the full loop:** 
 If your AI system makes a bad decision at 2am, that’s your decision. You monitor, you fix.
* **Comfortable with discomfort:** 
 Scope isn’t always clear. You figure it out rather than waiting for complete requirements.
* **Learns in public:** 
 You share half\-built things, ask for input, and improve — you don’t disappear for a month and emerge with something.



  





**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR: STRONG PREFERENCE** 




**✓** 
 Full\-stack engineering
 



**✓** 
 Product sensibility
 



**✓** 
 Requirements gathering
 



**✓** 
 LLM / AI\-native building
 



**✓** 
 Shipped to real users
 



**✓** 
 RAG or agents hands\-on
 



**✓** 
 Comfortable with ambiguity
 



**✓** 
 2–7 years in product \& tech
 



**→** 
 Startup experience
 



**→** 
 n8n / LangGraph / Cursor
 



**→** 
 BigQuery / dbt
 



**→** 
 Built solo products

title: Lead Deployment Engineer
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.
   

  

**Lead Deployment Engineer**
**The Team**
 Celonis Services is the delivery engine of our Celonis Customer Organization, responsible for turning the Celonis platform into measurable, business\-critical outcomes for our customers. In the AI era, our role has elevated: as AI agents like our own Apollo take on more of the technical build, our people focus on the work that drives real impact—understanding our customers' business\-critical problems, designing the solutions that solve them, and quantifying the value delivered. Our Deployment Engineers and Deployment Architects pair deep domain and industry expertise with serious platform mastery and AI\-augmented delivery, directing agentic systems while owning the judgment, architecture, and customer relationships that AI cannot replace. We deliver faster and smarter than ever, and we own the outcome: solution go\-live, solution adoption, initial value realization support and the long\-term success of our customers.
   

  

**The Role**
 As a Lead Deployment Engineer, you are the backbone of Celonis delivery. You lead the hands\-on implementation of Celonis solutions for enterprise customers, combining platform expertise with AI\-augmented workflows to deliver high\-quality outcomes, fast. You use Celonis’s AI deployment tools as your primary instruments \- directing agents to build data models, generate analyses, and configure operational solutions, while applying your own judgment to validate outputs, adapt to customer context, and ensure business relevance.
   

  

 This is not a traditional consulting role where you build everything manually. You are an AI\-augmented delivery professional: you specify what needs to be built, direct AI agents to execute wherever possible, validate the results, and iterate with the customer.
 **You generate value by understanding the customer’s business, translating their needs into technical specifications and solutions, and ensuring the platform delivers measurable impact.**
**The Work You’ll Do**
**Initiate and Connect**
* Conduct business discovery workshops to translate customers’ strategic objectives into high\-impact Celonis use cases
* Collaborate with the customer’s IT and business stakeholders to define project scope, data requirements, and success criteria
* Ensure data connectivity and extraction pipelines are properly configured, working with specialist resources if required


**Build \& Value**
* Direct AI deployment agents (Apollo) to build data models, process analyses, KPIs, and dashboards \- writing clear specifications and validating agent outputs against business requirements
* Build and configure Celonis solutions across the platform: Process Intelligence Graph, data transformations, process analysis, operational solutions, and AI\-powered insights
* Identify process inefficiencies and root causes using Celonis technology, always in close collaboration with the customer
* Validate AI\-generated outputs for accuracy, business relevance, and alignment with customer context \- applying domain knowledge where the AI cannot
* Lead value creation workshops and define measures to improve process inefficiencies
* Define and build KPIs measuring the customer’s success and quantify business impact
* Design and build operational solutions to drive value, adoption and improve process conformance


**Rollout, Adoption, and Handover**
* Enable key customer users to use and extend the solution independently, setting the foundation for long\-term adoption
* Manage project outcomes against timelines, scope, and customer expectations
* Train and demonstrate to customer users, guiding them on the path to sustained value
* Document solution design decisions and configurations for future reference and handoff


**Domain \& Industry Depth**
* Develop and maintain deep expertise in one or more process domains (e.g., Supply Chain, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, IT Service Management) or industry verticals
* Translate domain knowledge into scalable solution patterns, reference architectures, and best practices that the broader team can leverage
* Proactively identify and standardize high\-value use cases within your domain, collaborating with Product and Business Apps teams to shape the platform roadmap


**What Makes This Role Different In The AI Era**
* You work with AI agents as your primary tools \- your job is to direct, validate, and refine their output, not to write every line of code or build every analysis manually
* You need strong specification and context engineering skills \- the ability to translate a customer’s ambiguous business need into a precise instruction that an AI agent can execute correctly
* You are expected to continuously learn and adapt as AI capabilities evolve, experimenting with new approaches and sharing what works with your peers
* You balance speed with quality \- AI accelerates execution, but you own the judgment calls on whether the output is right for this customer
* You think in sustainable software solutions. While AI agents will generate first results quickly, you need to ensure that the operational solutions you build in Celonis are robust, user friendly, maintainable, and scalable


**The Qualifications You Need**
* Experience: A minimum of 8\+ years in Management or IT consulting, data/solution consulting, or process improvement consulting within software vendors, consulting firms, or system integrators.
* Platform skills: Ability to build and configure solutions on the Celonis platform, including data modeling, process analysis, KPI definition, and automation. Proficiency in PQL, SQL, and Python.
* AI fluency: Comfort working with AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.). Ability to write clear specifications, evaluate AI\-generated outputs, and iterate effectively. Experience with prompt engineering or context engineering is a strong plus.
* Business and process domain expertise : Strong understanding /deep expertise (based on seniority level) of enterprise business processes and financial metrics. Knowledge of standard ERPs (SAP, Oracle) and process areas (Inventory Management, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Accounts Payable) is a strong plus.
* Consulting skills: Ability to steer customer workshops, present findings to management, manage stakeholder expectations, and deliver outcomes in the face of adversity and ambiguity. Comfortable working with both technical and business audiences.
* Analytical mindset: Excellent problem\-solving skills with a value\-driven orientation. Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and quantify business impact.
* Learning agility: Willingness to continuously develop expertise through experimentation. Comfort with ambiguity and evolving tools.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Technology Management, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a comparable field.
* Languages: Fluency in English required. Additional languages are a plus.
* Travel: Willingness to travel to customer location up to 50%, according to customer requirement and project delivery phases.


**What Celonis can offer you:**
* Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI\-driven business operations.
* Ownership from Day 1: Every full\-time Celonaut is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit\-based refresh grants.
* Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
* Work\-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
* Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70\-20\-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
* Holistic Well\-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated Wellness Weeks that prioritize work/life balance.
* Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
* Global Inclusion \& Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
* Value\-Driven Impact: Join a mission\-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.


**About Us:**
 Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI\-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry\-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.
   

  

 Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.
   

  

**Celonis Inclusion Statement:**
 At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard \- that's when creativity and innovation happen.
   

  

**Your Privacy:**
 Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices
   

  

 By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) -Palantir Foundry
description:
**Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) – Palantir Foundry** 




  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a growth oriented Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who combines strong hands\-on Palantir Foundry capabilities with a deep understanding of Commercial, Marketing, CRM and Digital Growth. 
 



 We are looking for someone who thinks like a growth hacker and builds like an FDE — someone who understands how businesses acquire, engage, convert and retain customers, and can use data, AI and Palantir Foundry to rapidly turn growth ideas into working solutions.
 



 The ideal candidate is equally comfortable discussing customer journeys, CRM, social/media performance, campaigns and commercial growth opportunities with business teams and then getting hands\-on to build the required data products, applications and workflows in Foundry.
