title: Lead Specialist,Network Operations
description:
**Job Title: Lead Specialist, Network Engineer**

**About the role:**

This is an exciting opportunity to join our team as we continue to modernize and evolve our global network infrastructure. Built on a strong and well\-managed Cisco Meraki foundation, we are actively expanding our Zero Trust architecture and cloud security capabilities through Zscaler.


As a Network Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping the future of our network by helping to drive initiatives that improve connectivity, security, resiliency, and operational efficiency across the organization. You'll have the opportunity to work with modern enterprise networking technologies, participate in large\-scale infrastructure projects, and help guide the transition toward cloud\-delivered security and Zero Trust networking.


This role offers a unique blend of day\-to\-day operational support, network architecture, project delivery, and next\-generation security technologies. If you're passionate about networking, security, automation, and solving complex technical challenges, we'd love to hear from you.


**Position Summary**

We are seeking an experienced Network Engineer to design, implement, maintain, and support enterprise network infrastructure across multiple locations. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical knowledge of Cisco and Meraki networking technologies, cloud security platforms, routing and switching, and end\-user connectivity troubleshooting. This role requires hands\-on experience with network design, deployment, and operational support, as well as the ability to travel to company locations as needed.


**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, implement, and support enterprise LAN, WAN, wireless, and security infrastructure.
* Manage and support Cisco Meraki environments, including:
* Meraki Wireless Access Points
* Meraki MS Switching
* Meraki MX Security Appliances
* Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Cisco networking equipment, including:
* Cisco Routers
* Cisco Catalyst Switches
* Cisco ASA Firewalls
* Administer and support Zscaler cloud security solutions, including:
* Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA)
* Zscaler Private Access (ZPA)
* Zero Trust Branch (ZTB)
* Zscaler Branch Architecture (ZBA)
* Implement and support Zero Trust networking architectures and secure access solutions for branch offices and remote users.
* Configure, optimize, and troubleshoot routing protocols, including:
* BGP
* EIGRP
* OSPF
* Perform network capacity planning, architecture reviews, and infrastructure design.
* Lead network installations, upgrades, migrations, and refresh projects.
* Troubleshoot network, wireless, routing, switching, VPN, and security\-related issues.
* Diagnose and resolve connectivity and performance issues affecting:
* Windows clients
* macOS clients
* Coordinate network equipment procurement, asset lifecycle management, and vendor engagement.
* Work with service providers, vendors, and internal stakeholders to deliver network solutions.
* Create and maintain network diagrams, standards, operational procedures, and technical documentation.
* Participate in network incident response, root cause analysis, and problem management activities.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and provide recommendations that improve network performance, security, and operational efficiency.
* Support automation initiatives and continuously improve operational processes.
* Provide after\-hours support and participate in an on\-call rotation as required.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent work experience.
* 5\+ years of enterprise network engineering experience.
* Strong hands\-on experience supporting Cisco Meraki solutions, including wireless, switching, and MX security appliances.
* Experience configuring and troubleshooting Cisco routers, switches, and ASA firewalls.
* Experience administering Zscaler security platforms, including ZIA, ZPA, ZTB, and ZBA.
* Strong understanding of:
* TCP/IP
* DNS
* DHCP
* VLANs
* VPNs
* Network Security
* Wireless Networking
* Proven experience implementing and troubleshooting:
* BGP
* EIGRP
* OSPF
* Experience troubleshooting network\-related issues on both Windows and macOS endpoints.
* Experience with network architecture, deployment, and operational support.
* Strong analytical, documentation, and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Cisco CCNA, CCNP, or equivalent certification.
* Cisco Meraki CMNA, ECMS, or related certifications.
* Zscaler certifications or experience with Zero Trust architectures.
* Experience with network automation and scripting using Python, PowerShell, APIs, or similar tools.
* Experience supporting cloud networking environments such as AWS or Azure.
* Familiarity with network monitoring, performance management, and troubleshooting tools.
* Experience supporting global or multi\-site enterprise environments.
* Experience participating in network modernization and transformation initiatives.

**Travel Requirements**

* Ability to travel domestically and internationally as required.
* Travel may be required for:
* Network installations
* Site surveys
* Infrastructure upgrades
* Project deployments
* Troubleshooting and operational support
* Estimated travel requirement: 10\-25%.

**What You'll Work On**

As part of our team, you'll help drive initiatives including:


* Expansion of our Zscaler\-based Zero Trust architecture.
* Branch modernization leveraging Zero Trust Branch technologies.
* Global wireless, switching, and security refresh projects.
* Network automation and operational efficiency improvements.
* Cloud security and secure access transformation initiatives.
* Standardization and modernization of enterprise network services worldwide.

This is an opportunity to directly influence the future direction of our network and security architecture while working with industry\-leading technologies in a collaborative, global environment.


**Technical Skills Summary**

**Networking**

* Cisco Meraki Wireless
* Cisco Meraki Switching
* Cisco Meraki MX Security Appliances
* Cisco Routers
* Cisco Catalyst Switches
* Cisco ASA Firewalls
* LAN/WAN Technologies
* TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP
* VLANs and VPNs

**Routing**

title: Mechanical Inspector
description:
**Job Description: Mechanical Inspector– Machining, Fabrication \& Subsystem Inspection**

**Location: Chennai**

**Department:Quality Assurance / Manufacturing Quality / Assembly**

**Job Summary:**

We are seeking a skilled Mechanical Inspector with a strong background in inspection of

machined parts, fabricated components, and assembled subsystems. The role involves

verifying product quality at various stages of manufacturing and assembly, ensuring

compliance with drawings, standards, and customer requirements.

**Key Responsibilities:**

\- Perform in\-process and final inspections of machined and fabricated parts,

weldments, and subsystem assemblies.

\- Interpret engineering drawings and apply GD\&T principles for dimensional checks

using precision instruments.

\- Inspect features such as surface finish, flatness, hole alignment, concentricity, runout,

and thread parameters.

\- Verify welding quality, material conformance, and structural integrity of fabricated

components.

\- Check assembly fitment, alignment, movement clearances, and fastener torques in subsystems.

\- Ensure that non\-conforming items are identified, documented, and segregated.

\- Generate inspection reports, NCRs, and support root cause analysis and corrective

actions.

\- Work closely with production and design teams for real\-time feedback and resolution

of quality issues.

\- Maintain inspection tools, calibration records, and quality documentation.

\- Ensure adherence to ISO standards, safety norms, and company quality policies.

**Qualifications:**

\- Diploma / Degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field.

\- Degree with min.5 years and Diploma with 7\+ years of overall experience

\- 3–6 years of hands\-on experience in inspection of machined, fabricated, and assembled mechanical parts.

\- Strong understanding of GD\&T, surface finish specifications, welding standards, and

assembly techniques.

\- Proficient in using inspection instruments like micrometers, vernier calipers, height

gauges, surface testers, and bore gauges.

\- Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and manufacturing documentation.

\- NDT Level I/II certification is a plus. – ASNT \- VPT/MPT/UT

**Preferred Skills:**

\- Experience with CMM (manual or CNC) and digital inspection tools.

\- Basic knowledge of NDT, welding symbols, and fabrication standards (ASME, AWS,IS).

\- Exposure to ERP/QMS systems for inspection tracking and reporting.

\- Familiarity with Lean and Six Sigma principles is a plus.

The core functionality of JSOC team within Synchrony is to provide continuous monitoring and response to cyber threats against Synchrony, its employees, its customers and partners. The Manger, Detection and Response is part of the Synchrony Joint Security Operations Center (JSOC) and is responsible for being a subject matter expert in cyber detection of information security alerts and assisting in the investigation/reporting of major information security incidents supporting all business units. The candidate is expected to have a strong understanding of both traditional on\-premise security and cloud management plane (also known as cloud control plane) security.

The JSOC coordinates with IT, Legal, Human Resources, and other appropriate business units to gather incident details, assess impact, and coordinate response. * Respond to security incidents across a wide array of technologies, mitigate and contain impacts, coordinate remediation efforts, summarize and make recommendations to Sr. Management for improvements. Security technologies utilized by the JSOC team includes: Security Incident and Event Management (SIEM), Security Orchestration Automation and Response (SOAR), Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Web Application Firewall (WAF), network perimeter firewall, enterprise email security, User and Entity Behavioral Analytics (UEBA), and Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB) toolsets.
* Provide technical subject matter expertise to enable proactive detection of potential security threats and recommendations for improvements in overall security posture.
* Work with members of the Cyber Intelligence team to develop and implement threat detection logic to counter emerging cybersecurity threats.
* Develop and enhance Detection and Incident Response processes and procedures leveraging relationships with front line operations teams and exploiting tools and systems.
* Document findings and create detailed reports for constituency both in written and verbal formats.
* Enumerate risks and prioritize mitigation efforts based on clear business priorities.
* Coordinates IT resources to effectively perform incident response tasks.
* Acts as the subject matter expert on incident response tasks and takes responsibility for successful execution of incident response plan.
* Performs incident response tasks to contain exposures from an incident.
* Authors incident response reports and lessons learned to include root cause analysis.
* Identify and recommend process improvements.

* 2\+ years of experience in Security Operation Center
* Hands\-on experience with cloud security threats especially AWS and Azure related
* Experience with investigating critical security incidents related to endpoint and email compromise
* Strong understanding of identity security concepts (OAUTH, RBAC, UEBA etc.,)

* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to perform logical problem solving.
* Experience of working in high performing teams and understand the dynamics of teamwork in a SOC environment.

**Eligibility Criteria:**

* Minimum of 2 years of years of experience in information security or related technology experience required, experience in the securities or financial services industry is a plus.

title: Analyst
description:
Bei Roche kannst du ganz du selbst sein und wirst für deine einzigartigen Qualitäten geschätzt. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen. Hier wirst du für das, was du bist, wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert. Dies schafft ein Umfeld, in dem du sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich wachsen kannst. Gemeinsam wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und in Zukunft. Werde Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.
  
  

Die Position
  
  

Roche Services and Solutions India Pvt LTD
  
**Role:** Analyst (MDM Data Steward)
  
**Location:** Hyderabad / Chennai
  
**Job Type:** Full Time
  
Years of Relevant Experience in Analytics/Pharma/Biotech Domain: 2\+ Years
  
  

**About Us:**  

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
  
That’s what makes us Roche.
  
The Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) was established to drive analytics and technology\-driven solutions by partnering with Roche affiliates across the globe.
  
  

**The Opportunity:**  

As anAnalyst in the Data\& Insights Enablement team, you will join the GATE organization in a pivotal role partnering with the US\-based Master Data Management (MDM) team.
  
Your mission is to drive data stewardship, improve data quality, and support critical business decisions. You will act as a bridge between technical data operations and business strategy, ensuring our data assets are accurate, compliant, and actionable.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Master Data Management (MDM) Operations
  
  

* Data Change Requests: Lead the ongoing processing of Data Change Requests (DCRs) related to Health Care Master Data.
* Record Maintenance: Perform rigorous matching, merging, and maintenance of Master records (HCPs, HCOs, and Affiliations) to ensure a "single source of truth".


Data Stewardship\& Quality Assurance
  
  

* Stewardship: Act as the Data Steward for HCP (Health Care Professional), HCO (Health Care Organization) profile data, and Affiliations.
* Discrepancy Resolution: Proactively investigate data discrepancies from internal and external sources.
* Data Integrity: Ensure all newly onboarded datasets are accurate, complete, and strictly adhere to defined data standards.


Process Optimization\& Governance
  
  

* Governance Methodologies: Develop and document adaptable governance methodologies to enhance efficiency in MDM, data integration, taxonomy, and reporting.
* Automation: Identify opportunities to automate or improve data management workflows.
* Workflow Enhancement: Build data products to enhance workflow optimization.


Strategic Analysis
  
  

* Analytical Support: Provide analytical support to develop insights and strategies that optimize data\-related processes.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Collaborate with stakeholders across business functions to translate data into informed decision\-making.


**Who You Are:**  

Education\& Experience
  
  

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline.
* Experience: Hands\-on experience in Data Stewardship or Data Analytics operations.
* Industry Focus: Prior experience in the Pharma, Life Sciences, or Biotech industry is strongly preferred.


Technical Skills
  
  

* Core Data Skills: Advanced proficiency in Excel and SQL is required.
* Scripting: Practical knowledge of programming languages such as Python orPySpark.
* Domain Tools: Experience with MDM solutions (e.g., Reltio, Informatica MDM) and Pharma CRM solutions (e.g., Salesforce, OCE, Veeva CRM).
* Cloud Platforms: Working experience in AWS services (S3, Athena, Glue, Sagemaker Studio, EC2, API Gateway, Bedrock) Or other cloud platforms like GCP, Azure is a strong plus.


Key Competencies
  
  

* Analytical Mindset: Excellent problem\-solving skills with an unwavering focus on quality, accuracy, and detail.
* Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the abilitytomanage stakeholders and translate technical data issues for business audiences.


Wer wir sind
  
  

Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation an. Mehr als 100\.000 Mitarbeiter weltweit arbeiten gemeinsam daran, wissenschaftliche Fortschritte zu erzielen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und für zukünftige Generationen. Durch unser Engagement werden über 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt und mehr als 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostik\-Produkten durchgeführt. Wir ermutigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und hohe Ziele zu setzen, um lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen zu liefern.
  
  

Gemeinsam können wir eine gesündere Zukunft gestalten.
  
  

Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber, der die Chancengleichheit fördert.

* **Job requisition ID** : 109084

**The Team**



Deloitte helps organizations prevent cyberattacks and protect valuable assets. We believe in being secure, vigilant, and resilient—not only by looking at how to prevent and respond to attacks, but at how to manage cyber risk in a way that allows you to unleash new opportunities. Embed cyber risk at the start of strategy development for more effective management of information and technology risks. Learn more about Cybersecurity

  


**Your work profile**



This role is responsible for managing and validating data security controls across the organization, ensuring compliance with regulatory and internal requirements. You will focus on identity and access management controls, access control validation, database security controls, and evidence\-based assurance across on\-prem and cloud data environments.

  


**Key Skills Required**


* Work closely with technology, security, and data teams to manage and support data security control implementation.


* Assess control effectiveness and identify gaps in implementation


* Perform access control reviews with a focus on RBAC models and dynamic access review mechanisms.


* Validate identity and access management (IAM) controls across applications, databases, and infrastructure.


* Assess and monitor database access controls, including privileged access and segregation of duties.


* Identify and evaluate database access\-bypass scenarios and control gaps, including direct or unauthorized access patterns.


* Support periodic and event\-driven access reviews, ensuring timely remediation of access violations.


* Collect, validate, and document evidence to support access controls, audit requirements, and regulatory compliance.


* Analyze control testing results and escalate access\-related risks or violations to senior management.


* Support and manage regulatory and audit activities related to data security and access controls.


* Recommend and implement improvements to access control validation, monitoring, and reporting mechanisms.

  


**Qualifications:**


* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.


* 4\+ years of experience in Data Security, IAM, access control reviews, or cybersecurity GRC roles.


* Strong understanding of:



o Identity and Access Management (IAM) concepts



o Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC) and access governance models



o Database security and access controls


* Experience with security frameworks (NIST CSF, CIS, ISO 27001\).


* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.


* Excellent communication and documentation skills.


* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently.

  


**Good to Have:**


* Experience with access governance and IAM tools.


* Exposure to automation or scripting for access reviews and evidence validation.


* Familiarity with cloud\-based databases (AWS / Azure) and hybrid access models.


* Experience in detecting and analyzing access bypass scenarios between on\-prem and cloud environments.


* Relevant certifications (CISSP, CISA, CRISC, or IAM\-related certifications).

title: Manager, Clinical Trial Risk Analyst
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose\-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.  



  

**Duties/Responsibilities**

Mgr CTRA to contribute to Protocol De\-risking process, support identification of critical to success factors, critical to quality factors \- including critical data, critical processes  Collaborate with the Data Management Lead (DML), Statistician, Global Trial Lead (GTL), Quality Lead, Clinical Trial Physician, Clinical Scientist and other study team members to put together an initial proposal on KRIs (standard and study specific) and Quality Tolerance Limits (QTLs). Proposal to include information on critical data, data source, data flow, data review frequency, external data transfer frequency etc. Individuals printing or viewing a BMS controlled document from a source other than the Electronic Document Management System are responsible for ensuring that they are printing or viewing the current version. Page 2 of 3  Responsible to lead and collaborate with the study team in the development of specifications to set up the KRIs, Data Quality Assessments (DQA) and QTLs.  Partners with the DML and other data review functions to determine the holistic data review strategy for the study and determines the function specific review objectives/analytics. Documents the Risk Monitoring data analysis responsibilities in the relevant functional plan.  Responsible for regular risk monitoring at study level for and providing a holistic risk report at the agreed frequency. Ensure appropriate escalations of emerging risks (including QTL deviations) to the CTRL to be discussed at relevant governance bodies (e.g. Quality Council/Therapeutic Area leadership) and proactively shares knowledge and insights across the TRIM group.  Triages new and previously open signals in preparation for the Risk Review Meetings (RRM) to prioritize the signals for discussion and prepare a list of recommended actions  Contribute to the Risk Review discussion to determine if newly opened signals reveal potential risks and require follow\-up investigation and if previously opened signals can be closed or need further investigation/monitoring/action. Relates the insights from the CM analysis back to the original risk discussions to share a compelling ‘risk story’.  Drives or contributes to ongoing risk discussions within the study team throughout the lifecycle of the trial and ensures the risk management plan is updated and remains current  Contribute to the development and maintenance of metrics that inform the evaluation of risk monitoring performance and effectiveness.  Participation in initiatives / continuous improvement opportunities within the TRIM and broader organizations  Supports the strategic direction of Risk Based Management within the business to include leadership of RBM innovation, education and embedding  Ensure effective quality oversight and management of external partners (e.g. Function Service Providers, CROs, technology providers, etc.) performing Risk Management or Risk Monitoring activities on behalf of BMS  Takes on additional responsibilities as directed by leadership


**Reporting Relationship**

This role will report to a Clinical Trial Risk Analyst Line Manager within the TRIM organization.


**Qualifications**

A minimum of a bachelor’s degree in one of the following disciplines or related field: Life Sciences (preferred); Analytics; Data Science; Statistics; Business; is required. At least 3 years in the pharmaceutical industry with sound understanding of drug development and 3 years of experience in clinical trial operations and/or Good Clinical Practice is required. Robust understanding of Risk\-Based Monitoring principles (Quality by Design, Risk Assessment \& Control) and relevant tools (e.g. RACT, risk analytics platforms, Veeva and other quality systems) Individuals printing or viewing a BMS controlled document from a source other than the Electronic Document Management System are responsible for ensuring that they are printing or viewing the current version. Page 3 of 3 Technical expert in data analysis and interpretation using data visualizations to derive meaningful insights; and an ability to effectively tell the story of the data findings Ability to contribute to the development and implementation of data visualizations and analyses to support Risk Management / Risk Monitoring business needs. Robust understanding of GCP, compliance and regulatory expectations. Experience of audits and health authority inspections, root cause analysis and CAPA is desirable. Strong leadership skills with an ability to influence and manage key internal stakeholders Excellent communication, collaboration and teamwork skills with an ability to drive cross\-functional stakeholders to consensus. An ability to create a compelling story based on data insights which is meaningful to the target audience. An ability to make the connection between organizational strategy and departmental objectives, and utilize this understanding to drive priorities Open mindset with an ability to be flexible, responsive, and proactive in addressing new challenges, opportunities, and demands. Ability to quickly adapt to changes while maintaining effectiveness and staying aligned with business goals

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients.

**What you can expect of us**


As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well\-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

Siemens Mobility is an independent handled company of Siemens AG. * Shift from experience\-based to fact\-based decision\-making by the means of the enterprise repository

* Proven skills in the field of Enterprise Architecture Management, relevant certifications (e.g., TOGAF, PMP) is a plus.

title: Technology Support III
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

Take your application support career to the next level by supporting core liquidity, funding, capital, and market risk capabilities and improving platform stability through automation and disciplined controls. You will work closely with engineering and operations teams in a fast\-paced, high\-impact environment.


Job summary


As an Application Support Associate at JPMorgan Chase within Corporate Technology, you support mission\-critical banking applications across trading, treasury, risk, profit and loss, and regulatory/management reporting workflows. You operate with strong production discipline, partner with engineering and operations teams, and drive stability through incident reduction, automation, and effective controls. Guidelines.docx


**Job responsibilities**

* Provide Level 2 and Level 3 (L2/L3\) production support for mission\-critical applications supporting treasury, trading, risk, and reporting processes.
* Monitor application and batch health; triage failures, data breaks, and performance degradation to meet service level agreements (SLAs).
* Lead incident management activities including severity assessment, bridge coordination, stakeholder updates, and restoration to service.
* Troubleshoot using Linux, logs, metrics, and SQL to identify root causes and implement workarounds.
* Support batch orchestration and scheduling, including AutoSys and Airflow (including Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow), and validate upstream/downstream dependencies.
* Partner with engineering teams to deliver permanent fixes; contribute to problem management (root cause analysis, action plans, and prevention), and execute release/change support (deployment validation, rollback readiness, and hypercare) under change governance.
* Maintain operational excellence by supporting data pipelines and platform services (data lake and extract/transform/load patterns, Databricks), resolving data quality/process issues, creating and maintaining runbooks/standard operating procedures and operational knowledge, ensuring evidence capture and audit\-ready documentation, identifying business\-as\-usual toil, implementing automation via Python and shell scripting to improve mean time to restore, planning and executing disaster recovery/service recovery activities (runbook validation, failover/failback testing, stakeholder coordination, and post\-test remediation tracking to closure), and participating in on\-call/shift coverage for global processing windows.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Bring at least 6 years of application/production support experience supporting mission\-critical systems in banking or financial services.
* Demonstrate strong hands\-on experience with Linux and SQL, including deep troubleshooting using logs and metrics.
* Have hands\-on experience with scheduling and orchestration tools, including AutoSys and Airflow (including Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow), and supporting batch operations and dependency validation.
* Apply disciplined incident, problem, and change management practices (aligned to Information Technology Infrastructure Library principles), including clear, calm stakeholder communication under pressure.
* Show experience supporting data platforms and pipelines, including Databricks, data lake patterns, and extract/transform/load concepts, with the ability to resolve data quality and process issues.
* Use scripting and automation skills (Python and shell scripting) to reduce manual effort and improve platform stability and recovery outcomes.
* Work with observability tools such as Splunk, Grafana, Dynatrace, and/or OpenTelemetry, and demonstrate working knowledge of cloud and modern runtime platforms such as Amazon Web Services and Kubernetes, including cloud\-native services.

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Have experience with distributed systems, application programming interfaces, and data integration patterns.

The role collaborates with cross\-functional teams to build scalable, reliable, and production\-ready machine learning systems. Independently owns larger features or components and translates research ideas into efficient solutions with practical business impact. * Designs and implements targeted initiatives to optimize production efficiency and output, operating without supervision.

* Demonstrates understanding of how components and features impact the business, and ensures work is aligned with overall project outcomes.

title: Head of International Deposit & Payment Execution
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


The Head of International Deposit \& Payment Group Manager is a senior management level position responsible for accomplishing results through the management of a team or department in an effort to establish and implement new or revised application systems and programs in coordination with the Technology Team. The overall objective of this role is to drive applications systems analysis and programming activities.


We are seeking a highly strategic, technical, and people\-oriented **Product \& Technical Delivery Manager** to lead a high\-performing team of Technical Analysts. In this role, you will be responsible for the end\-to\-end lifecycle of our Deposits and Payments products, bridging the gap between business strategy and technical execution.


The ideal candidate possesses deep domain expertise in retail/wealth deposits and modern payment rails, combined with a proven track record of managing hybrid teams. You will champion agile methodologies, foster a culture of continuous improvement, and collaborate closely with engineering, architecture, operations, compliance, and business stakeholders to deliver secure, scalable, and customer\-centric financial solutions
  

  

**Responsibilities:**


* **Team Leadership \& People Management (35%)**
* **Direct Management:** Lead, mentor, and develop a hybrid team of Technical Analysts (focused on system requirements, API specifications, and data mapping).
* **Talent Development:** Establish clear performance goals, conduct regular career development discussions, and provide continuous coaching to elevate the team's product management and technical analysis capabilities.
* **Resource Allocation:** Manage capacity planning and resource allocation across multiple agile squads to ensure optimal delivery of the product roadmap.
* **Culture:** Foster an inclusive, collaborative, and high\-ownership environment that encourages innovation, technical excellence, and customer empathy.

**Risk \& Fraud:** Understanding of payment fraud prevention, transaction monitoring, Anti\-Money Laundering (AML), Know Your Customer (KYC), and Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) compliance


**Domain\-Specific Expertise (Deposits \& Payments)**


Candidates must demonstrate a strong understanding of the following areas:


**Core Deposits:** Account lifecycle management (onboarding, maintenance, closure), interest accrual and posting engines, fee structures, ledger systems, and statement generation. **Payment Rails:** Deep knowledge of domestic and international payment systems, including ACH, Wire transfers, Real\-Time Payments (RTP), FedNow, SWIFT, and ISO 20022 messaging standards. **Modern Architecture:** Familiarity with API\-driven banking (RESTful APIs, gRPC), event\-driven architectures (Kafka, RabbitMQ), and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).


**Stakeholder Management, Compliance \& Risk (20%)**


**Cross\-Functional Alignment:** Serve as the primary liaison between your team and key stakeholders across Engineering, Operations, Legal, Risk, Information Security, and Compliance. **Regulatory Compliance:** Ensure all deposits and payments products strictly adhere to local and international financial regulations, security standards, and data privacy laws. **Vendor Management:** Manage relationships with third\-party technology vendors, payment networks, and core banking providers, ensuring deliverables meet SLA and contractual obligations.


**Technical Analysis \& System Delivery (20%)**


**Technical Translation:** Guide Technical Analysts in translating complex business requirements into robust technical specifications, API contracts, data schemas, and system workflows. **Architecture Collaboration:** Work closely with Enterprise Architects and Lead Engineers to ensure product designs align with modern, scalable, and secure architectural standards (e.g., microservices, cloud\-native infrastructure). **Quality Assurance:** Oversee the definition of comprehensive testing strategies, including User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and integration testing, to ensure zero\-defect delivery. **Production Support:** Act as an escalation point for critical production incidents, ensuring rapid resolution and post\-mortem analysis to prevent recurrence.


**2\. Product Strategy \& Roadmap Execution (25%)**


**Roadmap Alignment:** Partner with business leaders to translate the overarching Deposits and Payments business strategy into a concrete, prioritized product roadmap. **Lifecycle Management:** Oversee the product lifecycle from conceptualization, market research, and business case development through to launch, maintenance, and decommissioning. **Agile Governance:** Ensure the team maintains a healthy, well\-prioritized product backlog with clearly defined user stories, acceptance criteria, and non\-functional requirements. **Metrics \& Analytics:** Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) for product health, adoption, transaction volume, and system reliability, using data to drive continuous optimization.


**Qualifications:**


* **Experience:**


	+ Minimum of **15\+ years** of experience in digital product management, technical analysis, or systems engineering within the financial services or FinTech sector.
	+ Minimum of **8\+ years** of direct people management experience, successfully leading hybrid teams of product and technical professionals.
* **Methodologies:** Strong expertise in Agile/Scrum frameworks, with experience acting as a Product Owner or Product Manager in a SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) or multi\-squad environment.
* **Tools:** Proficiency with product management and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, Productboard, and Miro.
* **Preferred Qualifications:**
* Master’s degree or MBA.
* Professional certifications: Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), Pragmatic Institute, Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI\-ACP), or Project Management Professional (PMP).
* Experience migrating legacy core banking or payment systems to modern, cloud\-native platforms.
* **Key Competencies \& Soft Skills**
* **Strategic Thinker:** Ability to see the big picture while maintaining a sharp eye for technical details and execution.
* **Influential Communicator:** Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non\-technical business stakeholders and vice versa.
* **Problem Solver:** Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with a calm and decisive demeanor under pressure.
* **Collaborative Leader:** Proven ability to build consensus, resolve conflicts, and drive alignment across highly matrixed organizations.

**Education:**


* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* Master’s degree preferred

title: AI/ML Evaluator - English
description:
**Job Overview**


We are seeking analytical and technically skilled **AI/ML Evaluators** to review and evaluate complex AI system behaviour using expert human judgment.


In this role, you will analyse AI system outputs, system telemetry, and other relevant technical signals to evaluate patterns of behaviour. A key part of the role will involve helping distinguish legitimate user activity from sophisticated automated or bot activity based on available data and defined project guidelines.


Your evaluations will provide high\-quality, human\-verified data used to train, evaluate, and improve AI systems. You will work with complex and sometimes ambiguous information, applying your understanding of AI/ML concepts and analytical reasoning to make accurate and consistent judgments.


An ideal candidate has a strong understanding of AI and machine learning concepts and is comfortable analysing technical data and system behaviour. You should be able to identify meaningful patterns, interpret complex signals, and make informed decisions based on evidence and project requirements.


Your work will help improve the accuracy and reliability of AI systems used to identify automated abuse while reducing the risk of incorrectly classifying legitimate user activity.


**Project Details**

* Contract Type: Freelance, with the potential to convert to a full\-time role.
* Pay Rate: US$9 per hour
* Location: India
* Language: English

**Responsibilities**


* Review and evaluate AI system behaviour, outputs, and relevant technical data according to defined project guidelines.
* Analyse system telemetry, event data, signals, and other technical information to identify meaningful patterns.
* Evaluate patterns and signals that may help distinguish legitimate user activity from automated or bot activity.
* Apply AI/ML knowledge and expert human judgment when reviewing complex or ambiguous cases.
* Identify unusual patterns, inconsistencies, or behaviours that may require further review.
* Evaluate complex cases using available evidence, context, and defined project requirements.
* Classify, label, or annotate assigned data accurately and consistently.
* Provide high\-quality human evaluations to support AI system training, evaluation, and improvement.
* Document decisions and supporting reasoning clearly when required.
* Identify unclear or unusual cases and flag them according to defined project processes.
* Apply detailed project guidelines consistently across assigned tasks.
* Maintain high levels of quality, accuracy, consistency, and attention to detail.

**Required Qualifications**


* Educational background or equivalent experience in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience working with AI/ML systems, machine learning models, AI evaluation, data analysis, or technical system analysis.
* Strong understanding of core AI and machine learning concepts.
* Ability to analyse complex technical data, system behaviour, and patterns.
* Experience evaluating AI systems, models, outputs, or data is preferred.
* Familiarity with system telemetry, event data, logs, or other technical signals is preferred.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to identify meaningful patterns and make informed decisions based on complex or incomplete information.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to apply detailed guidelines consistently.
* Experience with data annotation, AI evaluation, human feedback, model evaluation, or structured data review is preferred.
* Familiarity with bot detection, automated abuse detection, anomaly detection, fraud detection, or similar areas is preferred.
* Strong written English comprehension and documentation skills.

title: Project Leader (Procurement) - Performance Improvement CoE
description:
**About us**


Bain \& Company is a global management consulting firm that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 65 offices in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN is an integral and largest unit of (ECD) Expert Client Delivery. ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutioning across all industries, specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services.

This is a full\-time role based in Bain’s Gurugram (India) office and is part of the Performance Improvement Center of Expertise (PI CoE).


The PI CoE partners with Bain case teams globally to drive cost transformation and operational improvement programs across industries. The team supports a broad range of client engagements spanning: 1\) Procurement optimization (spend analytics, category strategy, vendor strategy, procurement maturity assessment), 2\) Supply chain optimization (inventory diagnostics, network optimization, manufacturing diagnostics, integrated business planning), 3\) Working capital and cost diagnostics and post\-merger integration and synergy analysis.


The team combines consulting problem\-solving with advanced analytics and technology\-enabled solutions, leveraging tools such as Alteryx, Tableau, and Power BI to deliver actionable insights and scalable solutions. The PI CoE also plays a key role in developing Bain intellectual property, reusable toolkits, and next\-generation AI/automation\-enabled solutions, including practical applications of GenAI tools to accelerate diagnostics, improve insight generation, and scale repeatable delivery models.

  

  

**What you'll do**

* Identify opportunities to codify repeatable casework into reusable products, accelerators, diagnostics, and delivery assets
  
  

**About you**

* Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands\-on execution


* Strong collaboration and leadership orientation

  

  

**What makes us a great place to work**


We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the \#1 consulting firm on Glassdoor's Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list for the last 12 years. We believe that diversity, inclusion, and collaboration are key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally. We are publicly recognized by external parties such as Fortune, Vault, Mogul, Working Mother, Glassdoor and the Human Rights Campaign for being a great place to work for diversity and inclusion, women, LGBTQ and parents.

title: ROSTER for Creative Services -Individual Consultant or Agency: Video Editor
description:
JOB DETAILS
  
**Type of contract :** Consultant Contract
  
  

**Level :** Level 2 \- Middle
  
  

**Hiring Unit :** Division for Communications and Public Engagement (CPE)
  
  

**Duty Station :** New Delhi
  
  

**Work location :** Remote
  
  

**Duration of contract :** 12 months
  
  

**Hiring open to :** External candidates
  
  

**Application deadline (Midnight UTC\+5 Time) :** 30/09/2026
  
  

**UNESCO Core Values:** Commitment to the Organization, Integrity, Respect for Diversity, Professionalism Long Description
  
  

CODE
  
  

CATEGORY
  
  

ROLES INCLUDED
  
  

CPE\-VE
  
  

Video Editors
  
  

Video Editors
  
  

The roster will be valid from 15 October 2026 to 31 December 2027, or until further notice. UNESCO reserves the right to extend or close the roster at any time.
  
  

OVERVIEW
  
UNESCO — the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization — works to build peace, eradicate poverty, and foster sustainable development through education, the sciences, culture, communication and information. The UNESCO Regional Office for South Asia, based in New Delhi, oversees UNESCO's programmes and partnerships across India, Sri Lanka, Maldives, Bhutan, Nepal, and Bangladesh, working closely with governments, civil society, and partners to advance these goals.
  
  

The Regional Office's Communications and Public Engagement (CPE) function is responsible for amplifying the visibility and impact of UNESCO's work across the region. This includes producing and disseminating content across digital and social media platforms, covering events and field activities, designing publications and communications materials, and managing UNESCO's regional brand presence. The CPE team works across all of UNESCO's programme sectors — education, culture, sciences, and communication and information.
  
  

To support this mandate, the UNESCO Regional Office for South Asia is seeking qualified individuals to join a Creative Services Roster. Rostered candidates will be selected for projects on an 'on\-call' basis, with no guarantee of assignment, to provide Video Editing services across a range of communications and public engagement activities.
  
  

The roster will be valid from 15 October 2026 to 31 December 2027, or until further notice. UNESCO reserves the right to extend or close the roster at any time. GENERAL CONDITIONS APPLICABLE TO ALL CATEGORIES
  
  

Type of Contract
  
  

Individual Consultant (Non\-Staff) or registered agency/firm. Contracts may be issued to individuals or legal entities depending on the nature and scale of the assignment.
  
Geographic Coverage
  
  

The roster is open to individuals and agencies based anywhere in South Asia. Candidates must clearly indicate in their application:
  
  

Their country of residence/base; and
  
The region(s) within India and/or countries in South Asia where they are available to undertake assignments.
  
  

Long Description
  
**Copyright and Intellectual Property Rights (All Categories):** All copyright and intellectual property rights in materials produced under this assignment shall vest in UNESCO. The selected candidate/consultant shall provide UNESCO with all final and editable/source files. UNESCO shall have the exclusive worldwide right to use, reproduce, adapt, publish, distribute and otherwise exploit the materials, in any form or on any platform. No material may be used, published, or reproduced by the candidate/consultant without prior written permission from UNESCO Regional Office for South Asia, New Delhi. All work must be original and must not infringe third\-party rights. AI\-generated images or videos are not permitted. COMPETENCIES \- Core (C) \& Managerial (M)
  
Communication (C)
  
Accountability (C)
  
Innovation (C)
  
Knowlegde sharing and continuous improvement (C)
  
Planning and organizing (C)
  
Results focus (C)
  
Teamwork (C)
  
  

For detailed information, please consult the UNESCO Competency Framework . Long Description BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVE
  
  

To enhance the visibility and impact of UNESCO's work in the region, the UNESCO Regional Office for South Asia (UNESCO New Delhi) is seeking qualified individuals and agencies to join a roster of video editors. Rostered candidates will be engaged on an 'on\-call' basis to provide post\-production support for UNESCO's digital and social media content needs.
  
  

A primary function of this roster is to engage video editors who can take raw footage — shot by UNESCO or its photographers and videographers — and produce high\-quality, platform\-optimized social media videos: short reels, YouTube clips, event wrap\-ups, campaign videos, and interview cuts. Candidates should be adept at fast\-turnaround, social\-media\-first editing in addition to longer\-form post\-production.
  
  

The call is open to individual video editors and registered agencies of any nationality who can deliver services remotely. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
  

Receive raw footage and/or project briefs from UNESCO and produce edited video content for social media platforms (Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, Facebook, X/Twitter, LinkedIn) and longer digital formats, as required.
  
Assemble edited sequences in accordance with agreed scripts, storyboards, creative briefs, or UNESCO direction; recommend pacing, cuts, and visual elements where appropriate.
  
Produce short\-form social media content — reels, clips, teaser videos, interview bytes — optimized for specific platforms in terms of duration, aspect ratio, and format.
  
Apply colour correction and grading, audio editing and synchronization, sound mixing, subtitling, captioning, lower\-thirds, motion graphics, and integration of voice\-overs and music, as required.
  
Long Description
  
  

Add and synchronize subtitles and captions as provided or directed by UNESCO.
  
Ensure all visual content is compliant with UNESCO Graphic Standards and Logo Toolkit, and include the UNESCO video outro where required.
  
Mainstream UNESCO's gender strategy and ensure gender\-balanced representation is reflected in the edited output.
  
Ensure all works comply with international copyright policy; no third\-party music, footage, or assets may be used without appropriate licensing.
  
Submit first\-round edits in MP4 format for UNESCO review; incorporate feedback and revisions until the video is considered satisfactory.
  
Deliver ready\-to\-publish files in MP4 format (H.264, appropriate resolution per platform) and the editable source/master file, including all linked assets, for archiving.
  
  

Meet committed deadlines; flag any anticipated delays promptly.
  
  

SCOPE OF WORK AND RATE PROPOSALS
  
  

Candidates must propose their daily rate in local currency for remote post\-production and editing services. Rates should cover:
  
  

**Daily rate for social media editing (short\-form content:** reels, clips, interview bytes); and
  
Daily rate for longer\-form post\-production (event documentation, documentary edits).
  
Long Description
  
  

UNESCO will specify the type and format of deliverable in each assignment brief. Rates should reflect the full scope of the editing task, including colour, audio, subtitling, and delivery.
  
  

DUTY STATION
  
  

All assignments are remote\-based. Raw footage and project briefs will be shared digitally by the UNESCO Responsible Officer. Candidates must maintain regular communication via email and online meetings throughout the assignment REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
  
EDUCATION
  
  

University degree and/or professional training in film production, video editing, broadcast media, digital communications, or related fields. A demonstrable portfolio will be considered in lieu of formal qualifications.
  
  

WORK EXPERIENCE
  
  

Minimum of three (3\) years of demonstrable professional experience in video editing, including experience in producing social media content. Experience with institutional or development\-sector communications is an asset Long Description
  
SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES
  
  

**Proficiency in industry\-standard video editing software:** Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or equivalent;
  
  

Demonstrated experience producing social media video content for Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, and LinkedIn — including reels, shorts, and platform\-optimized formats;
  
  

Strong understanding of post\-production workflows, colour grading, audio mixing, and multi\-format export;
  
  

Familiarity with motion graphics software (Adobe After Effects or equivalent) is an asset;
  
  

Experience with subtitle and closed\-caption integration;
  
  

Ability to manage and archive large media file libraries;
  
  

Ability to work independently and efficiently under tight deadlines and revision cycles;
  
  

Familiarity with UNESCO or UN branding standards is an advantage; and
  
  

**Note:** use of AI\-generated content or AI video/audio enhancement tools is prohibited unless expressly authorized by UNESCO.
  
  

LANGUAGES
  
  

Fluency in English (both oral and written) is required. Proficiency in local languages of the duty station is an asset. APPLICATION PROCESS
  
Interested candidates and agencies should apply through the UNESCO careers website (https://careers.unesco.org/) and follow these steps:
  
  

Create or log in to your account on the UNESCO careers website.
  
Download and complete your 'Employment History Form'.
  
  

**Prepare the following documents:**  

**Cover letter:** highlighting your most relevant skills and experiences and explaining how your qualifications make you suitable for the assignment(s) applied for. Please indicate the category code (CPE\-VE) to which you are applying, and clearly state your region of base (within India) or country of base (outside India) and the regions/countries where you are available to undertake assignment. Agencies should also include a brief organisational profile (year established, size, key clients).
  
**Curriculum vitae (CV):** outlining your professional and educational history, including contact information, work experience, software skills, and language skills. Agencies should submit CVs of at least two (2\) key personnel proposed for UNESCO assignments.
  
**Portfolio:** showcasing your relevant skills. The portfolio should include at least three (3\) recent work samples with brief descriptions of the project and your role. For CPE\-VE include links to online portfolios where possible.
  
**Standard service rates:** completed in accordance with the rate form relevant to each category applied for (see Annex I). Rates should be quoted in local currency. Agencies should indicate whether rates are per individual team member or per assignment.
  
Combine all items (Employment History Form, cover letter, CV or organisational profile, portfolio, and standard service rates) and upload as a single file under the 'Employment History' attachment section.
  
Complete or update your 'Candidate Profile'; save and submit your application.
  
  

SELECTION AND RECRUITMENT PROCESS
  
All candidates must complete an online application and provide complete and accurate information. No modifications can be made to the application submitted.
  
  

The evaluation of candidates is based on the criteria in the relevant Terms of Reference and the best value for money approach. This may include tests and/or assessments, as well as a competency\-based interview. UNESCO uses communication technologies such as video or teleconference and e\-mail correspondence for the assessment and evaluation of candidates.
  
  

UNESCO recalls that paramount consideration in the selection of candidates for inclusion in the roster shall be the need to secure the highest standards of efficiency, technical competence and integrity. UNESCO applies a zero\-tolerance policy against all forms of harassment.
  
  

UNESCO is committed to promoting equitable and diverse geographical representation, gender balance, and diversity in terms of nationality and culture in the composition of its rosters. Qualified candidates from non\- and under\-represented Member States are particularly welcome and strongly encouraged to apply. Individuals from minority and indigenous groups, as well as persons with disabilities, are equally encouraged to apply.
  
  

All applications and information submitted as part of the selection process will be treated with the highest level of confidentiality.
  
  

Inclusion in the roster does not guarantee assignment; candidates will be contacted on an on\-call basis depending on programme needs. Candidates in the final selection step for assignments will be subject to reference checks based on the information provided.
  
  

UNESCO does not charge a fee at any stage of the hiring process.
  
  

Long Description
  
EVALUATION CRITERIA
  
  

Selection for the roster will be based on a technical and financial evaluation in the ratio of 70:30\.
  
  

Individual candidates are assessed on personal experience, portfolio, and proposed rates.
  
  

Criteria

title: CEO
description:
**CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER (CEO)**

*This is not a conventional CEO role. After three decades building the foundation, Merits Capital is looking for a leader who can transform an established platform into one of India's most respected wealth institutions — a builder, not a manager.*

**About Merits Capital**

Merits Capital is a research\-driven wealth and investment management firm with over 33 years of experience in capital markets, investment advisory, and wealth management. Founded in 1993, the firm offers a comprehensive suite of solutions across Mutual Funds, PMS, AIFs, Private Equity, Insurance, and Algorithmic Investment Strategies.

**Who Should Apply**

This opportunity is for professionals who have already demonstrated the ability to build, scale, and lead.

* Successfully built and grown a business, vertical, or organisation
* A proven record of consistently delivering revenue
* Built high\-performing sales teams
* Implemented scalable systems, SOPs, and organisational structures
* Led multi\-functional teams successfully
* Earned the respect of clients and colleagues alike
* Strong academic credentials and high personal integrity

Key Responsibilities

* Investor Acquisition \& Capital Raising Support
* Take complete executive ownership of the organisation. The Founder will continue to drive vision, research, innovation, and strategic direction — everything else progressively becomes your responsibility.

**Key Result Areas**

**1\. Revenue Leadership** — Own the company's growth. Accountable for agreed targets on revenue, profitability, AUM, client acquisition, and client retention.

**2\. Build a High\-Performance Organisation** — Recruit, develop, and retain outstanding professionals. Create a culture where performance is recognised quickly.

**3\. Build Systems** — Institutionalise the company through SOPs, KPIs, dashboards, review systems, an accountability framework, and automation. The organisation should never depend on individuals.

**4\. Business Development** — Act as a business leader — bring meaningful relationships, open strategic opportunities, expand existing revenue streams, and build new distribution channels.

**5\. Leadership** — Lead every business function: Sales, Marketing, Wealth Management, Operations, HR, Technology, Finance, Compliance, and Customer Experience.

**6\. Build Future Leaders** — Create an organisation where leadership grows continuously.

**7\. Culture** — Build a workplace grounded in ownership, integrity, respect, learning, and execution.

**8\. Founder Independence** — Within 24 months, develop the systems and leadership needed to significantly reduce the Founder's operational involvement — freeing greater focus on strategy, research, innovation, and long\-term growth.

**What Makes This Different**

You won't inherit bureaucracy — you'll inherit a strong foundation:

* 33\+ years of credibility
* Deep research culture
* Strong technology orientation and AI\-ready vision
* A complete wealth ecosystem
* Entrepreneurial freedom and direct Founder access
* Fast decision\-making
* An ethical, client\-centric approach

**Ideal Profile**

* 15–25 years of leadership experience
* Strong academic record (preference for consistently high performers)
* Strong experience in leading and managing large, high\-performing teams
* Proven success in Wealth Management, Financial Services, or Capital Markets
* Prior work experience in Asset Management, Wealth Products, an Equity firm, or Banking (Wealth \& Financial Products)
* Demonstrated ability to build businesses — not merely manage them
* Should have some existing business / client relationships in hand
* Strong decision\-making ability and high emotional maturity
* Technology\-friendly, AI\-positive, and well versed with the use of AI in business
* Age group: 40–50 years (indicative)

**Preferred Evidence**

Candidates should ideally demonstrate one or more of the following:

* Successfully scaled a business or business vertical
* Built high\-performing teams from the ground up
* Delivered sustained revenue growth over multiple years
* Introduced systems, processes, or technology that materially improved business performance
* Earned industry recognition or leadership responsibility through measurable results
* Brings strategic client relationships and meaningful business opportunities

**What We Offer**

* Significant performance\-linked rewards
* Accelerated growth
* Quarterly performance reviews
* Entrepreneurial freedom
* Direct participation in building an institution
* Opportunity to create your own legacy
* Long\-term wealth creation opportunities

*We are not looking for someone to run a company. We are looking for someone who wants to help build an institution.*  
*If that resonates, we'd like to begin a conversation.*

title: IT Infrastructure & Network Lead
description:
**About the Organization**

Our client is a leading and rapidly growing enterprise in the automotive and mobility sector with a strong presence across multiple locations in India. The organization is committed to operational excellence, digital transformation, and delivering world\-class customer experiences. With a focus on innovation and technology\-driven business operations, the company is investing significantly in strengthening its IT infrastructure, cybersecurity, and end\-user services capabilities.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an IT Infrastructure \& Network Lead to manage and operate core

infrastructure across our multi location network. Reporting to the Head of IT Infrastructure \& End User Services,

this hands on technical role is responsible for network operations, cloud and on\-premises server environments,

and backup and recovery. The role ensures infrastructure reliability, performance, and security across all company

sites.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Network Management**

* Design, deploy, configure, and maintain LAN/WAN, VLAN, SD\-WAN, and wireless infrastructure across all

sites

* Monitor network performance, troubleshoot faults, and ensure high availability of connectivity across HQ,

plants, and remote locations

* Manage firewalls, routers, switches, and network security policies. Enforce segmentation standards
* Maintain network documentation including topology diagrams, IP addressing, and configuration records
* Evaluate and implement network upgrades and capacity expansions in line with business growth

**Cloud \& On\-Premises Infrastructure Management**

* Manage on\-premises server infrastructure (physical and virtual) including Windows Server, Active Directory

integration etc

* Administer and optimise cloud environments (primarily AWS) including compute, storage, networking, and

cost management.

* Maintain cloud architecture ensuring seamless integration between on\-prem and cloud workloads.
* Drive infrastructure\-as\-code and automation practices to improve provisioning efficiency and reduce

manual effort

* Manage data centre operations including hardware, cabling, power, and environmental monitoring

**Backup \& Recovery Management**

* Design and maintain backup policies, schedules, and retention frameworks for all critical systems and data
* Manage backup platforms and ensure successful completion of scheduled jobs across all sites
* Own and test Disaster Recovery (DR) and Business Continuity Planning (BCP) procedures on a regular basis
* Ensure offsite/cloud\-based backup replication and data protection compliance
* Respond to and manage recovery scenarios, minimising RTO and RPO impact

**Governance \& Compliance**

* Ensure infrastructure aligns with IT security standards, including patch management, vulnerability

assessments, and hardening guidelines

* Maintain configuration and change records in line with ITIL best practices
* Support IT audits and provide infrastructure related evidence and reporting as required

**Qualifications \& Experience**

* 5 to 10 years of IT experience, with at least 3 years in an infrastructure focused role
* Strong hands on experience with LAN/WAN, routing, switching, firewalls (Cisco, Fortinet, Palo Alto, or

equivalent)

* Solid knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory, and virtualisation platforms
* Demonstrated experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred). Familiarity with IaaS/PaaS services
* Experience managing enterprise backup platforms (Veeam, Commvault, or equivalent)
* Strong understanding of DR/BCP principles and testing
* Certifications desirable: CCNA/CCNP, AWS Certified SysOps Administrator or Azure Administrator (AZ\-104\)

or equivalent

* ITIL Foundation certification preferred.

**Technical Competencies:**

Networks: Aruba / Cisco / Fortinet / Palo Alto, SD\-WAN, VLAN, VPN, Wi\-Fi

Infrastructure: Windows Server, Active Directory, VMware/Hyper\-V, AWS

Backup: Veeam, Commvault

Monitoring: SolarWinds, PRTG, Zabbix or equivalent

title: Senior Accounts Payable Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
===================

**The Company:**


Cognex is the global leader in the dynamic and rapidly growing field of machine vision, generating annual revenue of $1 billion. We are a financially strong international organization with a culture that combines the energy and creativity of a startup with the stability of an established company.


Our employees, proudly known as “Cognoids,” take their work seriously—but never themselves. Our Work Hard, Play Hard, Move Fast culture celebrates innovation, perseverance, and results in a fun and rewarding environment. At Cognex, we value in\-person collaboration and teamwork, fostering an environment where ideas thrive and careers grow.

**The Role:**


The Senior Accounts Payable Specialist supports end‑to‑end AP processing for multiple global entities across the United States and Europe. This role manages the full lifecycle of PO and non‑PO invoices, ensures adherence to regional tax and regulatory requirements, and drives accuracy, timeliness, and compliance across a complex Procure‑to‑Pay (P2P) landscape. The position acts as a subject‑matter expert, supporting process standardization, cross‑regional alignment, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Essential Functions:**

**Global Invoice Processing (PO \& Non‑PO)**

* Manage daily AP operations for U.S. and European entities, ensuring accurate and timely processing of PO and non‑PO invoices.
* Perform detailed 3‑way match validations (PO, goods receipt, invoice) and coordinate with Procurement, Receiving, and business teams to resolve discrepancies.
* Process non‑PO invoices (e.g., utilities, rent, legal, professional services) ensuring appropriate approvals, cost center assignment, and documentation.
* Validate VAT treatments, tax codes, and country‑specific invoice requirements for EU entities (e.g., reverse charge rules, digital invoice formats, statutory fields).
* Ensure compliance with U.S. state and federal requirements, including 1099’s.
* Maintain accurate global vendor master data, including EU bank details (IBAN, SWIFT/BIC) and U.S. ACH/wire validations.

**Global Payment Execution**

* Manage and execute scheduled payment runs for U.S. and European entities, ensuring proper payment methods based on region (ACH, SEPA, manual wires)
* Verify payment approvals, bank instructions, and foreign currency transactions when needed.
* Monitor and resolve payment failures, returned payments, and reissue requests across varying regional banking systems.

**Vendor Management, Issue Resolution \& Stakeholder Support**

* Serve as the escalation point for complex invoices, vendor, tax, and payment issues across regions.
* Partner with Procurement, FP\&A, Controllers, and business stakeholders in both the U.S. and Europe to drive clarity on purchasing compliance and invoice processing requirements.
* Collaborate with vendors across time zones to resolve discrepancies, credits, missing documentation, or invoice disputes.
* Ensure accurate vendor setup and maintenance, including W‑9/W‑8 management and banking verification.
* Collaborate with vendors to resolve discrepancies, credit memos, and disputes.

**Month End Close and Reporting Responsibilities**

* Perform month‑end AP close activities across U.S. and European entities, including preparing and posting accruals for un‑invoiced goods/services, late vendor invoices, and recurring expenses; reviewing and reconciling GR/IR accounts to ensure accurate 3‑way match, timely clearing of open items, proper period cut‑off, and validating VAT/tax code treatments for EU invoices to ensure compliance.
* Complete monthly AP reconciliations by performing supplier statement reconciliations, resolving variances with the AP subledger, reconciling AP‑related balance sheet accounts (trade AP, non‑trade AP, accruals, GR/IR, and clearing accounts), and reviewing AP aging to ensure timely follow‑up on overdue items, unmatched invoices, debit balances, and other exceptions.
* Support audit and compliance requirements by providing reconciliations, documentation, and samples for internal, external, SOX, and statutory audits; maintain adherence to U.S. GAAP, SOX controls, and European statutory standards, and proactively identify and resolve recurring issues impacting close such as unmatched POs, delayed goods receipts, or late approvals.

**Process Improvement \& Systems**

* Identify and lead improvements in AP workflows, automation, and self\-service capabilities.
* Act as a super user or SME for AP technology (e.g., ERP systems, OCR/AI tools, e‑invoicing, Levelpath or similar P2P tools).
* Support testing and implementation of new systems, enhancements, and process redesigns.

**Cross‑Functional Partnership**

* Work closely with Procurement, FP\&A, Treasury, and operations teams to ensure a seamless P2P workflow.
* Support training for internal teams and field users on AP policies and best practices.
* Mentor junior AP staff and contribute to team knowledge development.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**

**Core Competencies**

* **Global Mindset:** Understands regional differences and can operate effectively across markets.
* **Operational Excellence:** Ensures accuracy, timeliness, controls, and high‑quality service delivery.
* **Problem Solving:** Resolves complex invoices, tax, system, and payment challenges independently.
* **Customer Focus:** Provides strong vendor and stakeholder support across multiple time zones.
* **Collaboration:** Works effectively with cross‑functional and cross‑regional teams.
* **Technical Aptitude:** Quickly adapts to systems, automation tools, and global P2P technologies.

**Qualifications:**

**Required**

* B.S. degree in Finance\-related field
* 6\+ years of progressive Accounts Payable experience, preferably in a shared services or global delivery model.
* Strong understanding of P2P processes, 3‑way match, purchasing policies, and invoice controls.
* Experience with enterprise ERP (e.g., SAP, SAP Concur, Levelpath, Workday, Service Now).
* High attention to detail, analytical mindset, and strong problem\-solving skills.
* Demonstrated ability to work in tight corporate deadlines and fast paced environment.
* Ability to work independently and communicate with all levels of the organization and customers.

**Location:**


Onsite – Noida, India

title: Construction Estimator – AI Product
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a **Construction Estimator** with hands\-on experience in reading construction drawings and performing quantity takeoffs.

In this role, you will work closely with our AI product team as a **construction domain specialist**. Your primary responsibility will be to review, audit, and verify AI\-generated results against actual construction drawings and estimating requirements.

This is a great opportunity for someone with practical estimating experience who is interested in working with an AI product and contributing to the accuracy and reliability of AI\-powered construction estimating workflows.

Key Responsibilities

* Review and interpret **construction blueprints, plans, and technical drawings**.
* Perform construction **quantity takeoffs** and validate quantities against drawings and project requirements.
* Review AI\-generated takeoff and estimating results for accuracy and completeness.
* Identify errors, discrepancies, missing items, and incorrect quantities in AI\-generated results.
* Audit AI outputs and provide accurate feedback to help improve product performance.
* Verify measurements, quantities, materials, and other estimating\-related information.
* Follow standardized processes for reviewing and validating AI\-generated results.
* Work closely with the product and technology teams to communicate construction\-specific requirements, exceptions, and edge cases.
* Identify areas where AI may misinterpret drawings, symbols, specifications, or construction details.
* Maintain accuracy and consistency while reviewing large volumes of construction drawings and AI\-generated outputs.

What We're Looking For

* **1\+ years of experience in construction estimating** or a closely related role.
* Strong ability to read and understand **construction blueprints, plans, and technical drawings**.
* Hands\-on experience with **quantity takeoffs** and construction estimating workflows.
* Good understanding of construction materials, measurements, and common construction terminology.
* Experience using **Bluebeam** or other construction takeoff/estimating software.
* Highly systematic and detail\-oriented approach to reviewing drawings and quantities.
* Strong ability to identify discrepancies and accurately verify information.
* Comfortable working with technology and learning AI\-based tools.
* Good communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain errors, discrepancies, and construction\-specific requirements.
* Ability to work independently and follow structured processes.

Preferred

* Experience working with multiple types of construction drawings and projects.
* Familiarity with digital takeoff and estimating platforms.
* Experience reviewing or auditing estimates prepared by others.
* Interest in AI, automation, or construction technology is a plus.

Pay: ₹24,000\.00 \- ₹26,000\.00 per month

* Internet reimbursement
* Provident Fund
* Work from home
