title: Knowledge Analyst - Private Capital
description:
**Who You'll Work With**
 Driving lasting impact and building long\-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture \- doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.
   

  

 In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.
   

  

 When you join us, you will have:
   

  

* Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast\-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
* A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
* Global community: With colleagues across 65\+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
* World\-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well\-being for you and your family.


**Your Impact**
 You will be based in Gurugram as part of McKinsey’s Private Capital practice, where you will drive technology\-led problem solving for private capital clients and client service teams under the guidance of senior content and technology experts.
   

  

 Your core mandate will be to build — designing and shipping automated solutions, analytical tools, workflows, agentic assets, and proof\-of\-concept prototypes that make research and knowledge development materially faster and more efficient. You will use AI\-enabled development environments and low\-code/no\-code platforms to take ideas from concept to working MVP, then iterate them into durable, reusable assets. You will apply these technology\-enabled approaches to help client teams address specific business questions across Private Equity and other institutional investors, portfolio companies, and the broader private capital ecosystem — spanning deal sourcing and screening, due diligence, value creation, portfolio performance, and exit.
   

  

 You will convert raw, unstructured inputs — filings, transaction data, proprietary databases, market and alternative data — into structured outputs, dashboards, and insight layers linked to the questions that matter to clients. You will build and maintain the practice’s proprietary analytical tools, benchmarking databases, and data pipelines, and support their deployment on live engagements. You will codify learnings, emerging ideas, reusable tools, and best practices that strengthen the Private Capital practice’s technology and knowledge infrastructure, and you will share relevant knowledge and emerging practices on GenAI and agentic workflows across the practice.
   

  

 You will support client proposals and other client development efforts by helping gather, structure, and apply relevant knowledge, data, and capabilities. Throughout, you will work directly with McKinsey consultants, client representatives, and global Private Capital experts, contributing to problem solving, analysis, and the development of recommendations for clients globally. You may be required to travel to client locations within or outside of India.
   

  

**Your Qualifications and Skills**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Electronics/circuit branches, Data Science, AI, or a quantitative discipline; Master’s is a plus
* 1\+ year\+ of full\-time experience with exposure to digital or AI\-enabled ways of working, hands\-on involvement in AI\-based builds \- shipped tools, automations, models, or agentic workflows, not solely exploratory or coursework projects
* Proven, hands\-on experience building functional prototypes and MVPs using AI developer tools (e.g., Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude), LLM APIs, prompt engineering, RAG/agentic workflows and low code/automation platforms (e.g., Power Platform, n8n, Alteryx)
* Strong proficiency in Python and SQL (R, JavaScript, or open\-source languages a plus), alongside practical knowledge of data extraction, cleaning, pipelines, API integration, visualization (Power BI, Tableau), and Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
* Solid grasp of financial, economic, and business concepts (exposure to PE, private credit, M\&A, or investment research is highly desirable), with strong instincts for root\-cause problem solving, research, synthesis, and client\-impact delivery
* Highly collaborative, organized, and adaptable to work independently under pressure and proactively learn evolving technologies.
* Clear English communication skills to translate complex technical concepts for non\-technical stakeholders

title: Delivery Lead - Taxation
description:
Job Description
Job description


Acuity Analytics (the trading name of Acuity Knowledge Partners) is a global, tech\-first organization helping financial institutions and corporates make better decisions through research, data, analytics and AI\-enabled solutions. We combine deep financial services expertise with strong engineering, digital and AI capabilities to solve complex, real\-world problems.


With a team of 7,200\+ analysts, data specialists and technologists across 28 locations, we work with more than 800 organizations worldwide to drive efficiency, unlock insight and deliver measurable impact. Our success is built on the strength of our people—by investing in talent, encouraging collaboration and creating room to grow, we enable our teams to do their best work for clients.


Acuity became an independent business in 2019 following its acquisition from Moody’s Corporation by Equistone Partners Europe. In 2023, funds advised by global private equity firm Permira acquired a majority stake, with Equistone remaining a minority investor—supporting our continued growth and innovation.


For more information, visit www.acuityanalytics.com


Basic information  

  

**Position Title**  

Delivery Lead

  

**Experience Level**  

8 years and above  

  

**Department**  

Private Markets

  

**Location**  

Gurugram

  

  

Organizational relationships

  

  

**Position reports to**

  

Delivery Manager  

  

Job purpose

  

  

We are seeking a detail\-oriented and proactive Tax Compliance \& Reporting Specialist to manage Australian tax compliance, investor reporting, and tax documentation for our clients. The role involves coordination with cross\-functional teams, external advisors, and fund administrators to ensure accurate and timely tax filings and reporting.

  

  

Key responsibilities  

  

n **Annual Compliance \& Filings:** Coordinate and review Australian Federal and State tax filings ensure timely and accurate disclosures.


n **Quarterly Estimates:** Calculate and file estimated tax payments; maintain supporting workpapers and reconciliations.


n **AAS/AASB Audit Support:** Assist with tax provisions, deferred tax calculations, and footnote documentation for audits.


n **ATO Exemptions:** Monitoring \& determining eligibility for exemptions like remitting amounts to the ATO via single touch payroll


n **Tax Structuring:** Prepare equity playbooks and tax memos; support deal structuring and tax\-efficient distribution planning.


n **Tax Authority Correspondence:** Track and respond to ATO Tax legislations/state notices; escalate and coordinate with legal and external advisors.


n **Tax Form Management:** Prepare and update Australian tax forms (TFN, NAT0 660, NAT 0659, NAT 71121\); ensure compliance and documentation accuracy.


n **Withholding \& Exemptions:** Apply PAYG withholding rules (CFI, Treaty Relief, interest withholding tax exemptions, etc); determine exemption eligibility and maintain accurate records.

  

n **Legal Document Integration:** Update Ontra (or similar platforms) with tax terms, filing statuses, and compliance checkpoints from legal agreements.


n **Client Coordination:** Serve as a key contact for tax\-related client communications; ensure timely updates and document uploads to internal and external platforms.


n **Data Reconciliation:** Reconcile investor/entity data between internal systems and external platforms.


n **PFIC Statement Management:** Request, track, and manage PFIC statements for relevant entities.

  

  

Key competencies

  

  

* 7\+ years of experience in Australian taxation, preferably in tax compliance, legal/tax advisory firms.


* Strong knowledge of Partnership taxation, Individual taxation, Trust, PAYG Reporting and Investment fund structures (FoFs, Private Equity, Credit).


* Hands\-on experience with Australian withholding tax rules and exemption certifications \& notice management


* Familiarity with tax compliance software (e.g., GoSystem, CCH Axcess, OneSource, Enterprise tax reporting and compliance) and tax research tools (e.g., CCH iKnowConnect, Checkpoint, ATO Website).


* Excellent analytical, organizational, and communication skills.


* CA, CPA Australia preferred.


* Excellent in MS Excel to process varied data sets


* Ability to work effectively under tight deadlines


* Should be an independent contributor and his/her work require minimal QC

description:
**Who we are**
--------------



VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology \& Transformation.

This partnership is a unique, industry\-first model which brings together the best of in\-house and 3rd party capability.
  

We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  

\#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture

**About this Role**
-------------------



We are seeking an experienced Treasury Cash Management professional to lead cash accounting, bank reconciliations, payment controls and banking operations within a complex, multi\-entity environment based in Ahmedabad. This role combines treasury operations expertise with digital transformation capabilities to improve financial control, operational efficiency and automation. The successful candidate will work closely with Finance, Technology, Risk, Cyber Security, banking partners and external providers to build scalable, technology\-enabled treasury processes while ensuring accurate accounting, regulatory compliance and strong governance.

**What you’ll do**
------------------


### **Lead Cash Accounting and Reconciliations**

* Own daily and period\-end cash accounting, ensuring transactions are complete, accurate and appropriately recorded in the ERP and relevant sub\-ledgers.
* Lead reconciliations across bank statements, payment platforms, collection files, clearing accounts, cash\-in\-transit accounts and the general ledger.
* Drive timely resolution of unmatched, duplicated, rejected, returned and aged items with appropriate ownership and supporting documentation.
* Establish consistent standards for reconciliation frequency, ageing, review, certification, evidence retention and escalation.

### **Own Bank Reconciliations and Banking Operations**

* Lead end\-to\-end bank reconciliations across bank accounts, entities and currencies.
* Ensure bank statements and transaction files are received completely and processed accurately through approved connectivity channels.
* Oversee bank account postings, charges, collections, direct debits, payment returns, unidentified receipts and related accounting treatment.
* Manage bank account administration, mandates, signatories, access governance and periodic user access reviews.
* Collaborate with banks and internal teams to resolve statement, interface, value\-date and transaction discrepancies.

### **Strengthen Payments, Controls and Financial Close**

* Oversee secure and timely payment processing, including file validation, approvals, release controls and accounting for payment outcomes.
* Monitor failed, rejected, duplicate, delayed and returned payments and lead root cause resolution.
* Lead month\-end cash and banking close activities, including journal reviews, reconciliation certification, aged\-item reporting and balance sheet commentary.
* Maintain robust segregation of duties, maker\-checker processes, access controls, audit trails and control evidence.

### **Drive FinTech and Digital Transformation**

* Identify and implement automation opportunities across matching, reconciliations, exception management, reporting and bank administration.
* Lead implementation and enhancement initiatives across Treasury Management Systems, reconciliation platforms, ERP modules, workflow solutions and payment technologies.
* Advance API\-based and host\-to\-host banking connectivity and straight\-through processing where appropriate.
* Apply analytics, AI\-assisted matching, anomaly detection and rules\-based automation to improve control effectiveness and reduce manual effort.
* Own business requirements, process design, user acceptance testing, deployment readiness and benefit realisation activities for treasury technology initiatives.

### **Lead People and Stakeholder Relationships**

* Coach, support and develop the Treasury Cash Management team, strengthening accounting, reconciliation, controls and digital capabilities.
* Partner with Finance, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Controllership, Technology, Cyber Security, Risk, banking partners, FinTech providers and auditors.
* Lead governance reviews, communicate risks and issues clearly, and ensure actions are tracked and completed.
**Who you are**
---------------


* Typically bring 6 to 12 years of experience in treasury operations, cash and banking, financial operations or shared services environments, including people leadership responsibilities.
* Demonstrate experience managing high\-volume cash and bank reconciliations within multi\-entity and/or multi\-currency organisations.
* Possess strong knowledge of cash accounting, payment processing, clearing accounts, month\-end close processes, balance sheet controls and reconciliation governance.
* Have hands\-on experience with ERP systems, Treasury Management Systems, bank connectivity solutions, reconciliation platforms, workflow tools and automation technologies.

title: AI/ML Engineer
description:
How we hire
**Our** **hiring process**
--------------------------


We respect your time. Our process is fast, transparent, and built around real conversations — not trick questions.


01
### **Apply online**


Submit your CV and a short note. We read every application personally — no ATS black holes.


02
### **Intro call**


A 30\-minute chat with our hiring lead to discuss the role, your background, and mutual fit.


03
### **Technical interview**


A focused 60\-minute session — real\-world problems, not whiteboard puzzles. Paid for senior roles.


04
### **Offer \& onboard**


Fast decisions, clear offers, and a structured 30\-day onboarding so you hit the ground running.


  
Pune / Remote Full Time 3\+ years  


As an AI/ML Engineer at KadamTech, you will build AI agents, **RAG** pipelines, and intelligent automation that solve concrete business problems rather than demos that never leave a notebook. You will work primarily in **Python**, integrating large language models, embedding stores, and vector databases into products that customer\-support teams, analysts, and operations staff actually use every day.


The problems are diverse and practical. You might build a retrieval\-augmented assistant over a client's knowledge base, design an automation that classifies and routes thousands of documents, or wire up an agentic workflow that takes actions across multiple tools and APIs. A big part of the job is rigorous evaluation: defining what "good" means for a given task, building test sets, measuring quality and cost, and tuning prompts, retrieval, and models until the system is genuinely reliable.


This role is exciting because you sit at the intersection of fast\-moving research and real production engineering. You will own features from prototype to deployment, make pragmatic calls on build\-versus\-buy, and put guardrails around models so they behave safely and predictably. If you like shipping AI that earns its keep, you will have a lot of room to make an impact here.


**What you'll do**
------------------


* Build and ship LLM\-powered features such as assistants, summarisers, and classifiers
* Design and implement RAG pipelines, including chunking, embeddings, and retrieval strategies
* Develop agentic and automation workflows that integrate multiple tools and APIs
* Define evaluation criteria and build test sets to measure model quality, latency, and cost
* Optimise prompts, retrieval, and model selection to improve accuracy and reduce spend
* Deploy models and pipelines to production with monitoring, logging, and safety guardrails
* Collaborate with engineering and clients to scope realistic, high\-value AI use cases
**What we're looking for**
--------------------------


* 3\+ years of software engineering experience, with strong production\-grade Python skills
* Hands\-on experience with LLM APIs (e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic) and prompt engineering
* Experience building RAG systems and working with vector databases (e.g. pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate)
* Working understanding of MLOps basics: deployment, monitoring, and versioning
* A rigorous, evaluation\-driven approach to measuring and improving model quality
* Pragmatic, outcome\-focused mindset that prioritises shipping reliable solutions
* Nice to have: experience with fine\-tuning, orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex), or cloud ML services
